  idx = g->cur_x + g->cur_y;
  p = &g->out[idx];
  g->history[idx / 4] = 1;

  c = &g->color_table[g->codes[code].suffix * 4];
  if (c[3] > 128) { // don't render transparent pixels;
    p[0] = c[2];
    p[1] = c[1];
    p[2] = c[0];
    p[3] = c[3];
  }
  g->cur_x += 4;

  if (g->cur_x >= g->max_x) {
    g->cur_x = g->start_x;
    g->cur_y += g->step;

    while (g->cur_y >= g->max_y && g->parse > 0) {
      g->step = (1 << g->parse) * g->line_size;
      g->cur_y = g->start_y + (g->step >> 1);
      --g->parse;
    }
  }
}

static stbi_uc *stbi__process_gif_raster(stbi__context *s, stbi__gif *g) {
  stbi_uc lzw_cs;
  stbi__int32 len, init_code;
  stbi__uint32 first;
  stbi__int32 codesize, codemask, avail, oldcode, bits, valid_bits, clear;
  stbi__gif_lzw *p;

  lzw_cs = stbi__get8(s);
  if (lzw_cs > 12)
    return NULL;
  clear = 1 << lzw_cs;
  first = 1;
  codesize = lzw_cs + 1;
  codemask = (1 << codesize) - 1;
  bits = 0;
  valid_bits = 0;
  for (init_code = 0; init_code < clear; init_code++) {
    g->codes[init_code].prefix = -1;
    g->codes[init_code].first = (stbi_uc)init_code;
    g->codes[init_code].suffix = (stbi_uc)init_code;
  }

  // support no starting clear code
  avail = clear + 2;
  oldcode = -1;

  len = 0;
  for (;;) {
    if (valid_bits < codesize) {
      if (len == 0) {
        len = stbi__get8(s); // start new block
        if (len == 0)
          return g->out;
      }
      --len;
      bits |= (stbi__int32)stbi__get8(s) << valid_bits;
      valid_bits += 8;
    } else {
      stbi__int32 code = bits & codemask;
      bits >>= codesize;
      valid_bits -= codesize;
      // @OPTIMIZE: is there some way we can accelerate the non-clear path?
      if (code == clear) { // clear code
        codesize = lzw_cs + 1;
        codemask = (1 << codesize) - 1;
        avail = clear + 2;
        oldcode = -1;
        first = 0;
      } else if (code == clear + 1) { // end of stream code
        stbi__skip(s, len);
        while ((len = stbi__get8(s)) > 0)
          stbi__skip(s, len);
        return g->out;
      } else if (code <= avail) {
        if (first) {
          return stbi__errpuc("no clear code", "Corrupt GIF");
        }

        if (oldcode >= 0) {
          p = &g->codes[avail++];
          if (avail > 8192) {
            return stbi__errpuc("too many codes", "Corrupt GIF");
          }

          p->prefix = (stbi__int16)oldcode;
          p->first = g->codes[oldcode].first;
          p->suffix = (code == avail) ? p->first : g->codes[code].first;
        } else if (code == avail)
          return stbi__errpuc("illegal code in raster", "Corrupt GIF");

        stbi__out_gif_code(g, (stbi__uint16)code);

        if ((avail & codemask) == 0 && avail <= 0x0FFF) {
          codesize++;
          codemask = (1 << codesize) - 1;
        }

        oldcode = code;
      } else {
        return stbi__errpuc("illegal code in raster", "Corrupt GIF");
      }
    }
  }
}

// this function is designed to support animated gifs, although stb_image
// doesn't support it two back is the image from two frames ago, used for a very
// specific disposal format
static stbi_uc *stbi__gif_load_next(stbi__context *s, stbi__gif *g, int *comp,
                                    int req_comp, stbi_uc *two_back) {
  int dispose;
  int first_frame;
  int pi;
  int pcount;
  STBI_NOTUSED(req_comp);

  // on first frame, any non-written pixels get the background colour
  // (non-transparent)
  first_frame = 0;
  if (g->out == 0) {
    if (!stbi__gif_header(s, g, comp, 0))
      return 0; // stbi__g_failure_reason set by stbi__gif_header
    if (!stbi__mad3sizes_valid(4, g->w, g->h, 0))
      return stbi__errpuc("too large", "GIF image is too large");
    pcount = g->w * g->h;
    g->out = (stbi_uc *)stbi__malloc(4 * pcount);
    g->background = (stbi_uc *)stbi__malloc(4 * pcount);
    g->history = (stbi_uc *)stbi__malloc(pcount);
    if (!g->out || !g->background || !g->history)
      return stbi__errpuc("outofmem", "Out of memory");

    // image is treated as "transparent" at the start - ie, nothing overwrites
    // the current background; background colour is only used for pixels that
    // are not rendered first frame, after that "background" color refers to the
    // color that was there the previous frame.
    memset(g->out, 0x00, 4 * pcount);
    memset(g->background, 0x00,
           4 * pcount); // state of the background (starts transparent)
    memset(g->history, 0x00,
           pcount); // pixels that were affected previous frame
    first_frame = 1;
  } else {
    // second frame - how do we dispoase of the previous one?
    dispose = (g->eflags & 0x1C) >> 2;
    pcount = g->w * g->h;

    if ((dispose == 3) && (two_back == 0)) {
      dispose = 2; // if I don't have an image to revert back to, default to the
                   // old background
    }

    if (dispose == 3) { // use previous graphic
      for (pi = 0; pi < pcount; ++pi) {
        if (g->history[pi]) {
          memcpy(&g->out[pi * 4], &two_back[pi * 4], 4);
        }
      }
    } else if (dispose == 2) {
      // restore what was changed last frame to background before that frame;
      for (pi = 0; pi < pcount; ++pi) {
        if (g->history[pi]) {
          memcpy(&g->out[pi * 4], &g->background[pi * 4], 4);
        }
      }
    } else {
      // This is a non-disposal case eithe way, so just
      // leave the pixels as is, and they will become the new background
      // 1: do not dispose
      // 0:  not specified.
    }

    // background is what out is after the undoing of the previou frame;
    memcpy(g->background, g->out, 4 * g->w * g->h);
  }

  // clear my history;
  memset(g->history, 0x00,
         g->w * g->h); // pixels that were affected previous frame

  for (;;) {
    int tag = stbi__get8(s);
    switch (tag) {
    case 0x2C: /* Image Descriptor */
    {
      stbi__int32 x, y, w, h;
      stbi_uc *o;

      x = stbi__get16le(s);
      y = stbi__get16le(s);
      w = stbi__get16le(s);
      h = stbi__get16le(s);
      if (((x + w) > (g->w)) || ((y + h) > (g->h)))
        return stbi__errpuc("bad Image Descriptor", "Corrupt GIF");

      g->line_size = g->w * 4;
      g->start_x = x * 4;
      g->start_y = y * g->line_size;
      g->max_x = g->start_x + w * 4;
      g->max_y = g->start_y + h * g->line_size;
      g->cur_x = g->start_x;
      g->cur_y = g->start_y;

      // if the width of the specified rectangle is 0, that means
      // we may not see *any* pixels or the image is malformed;
      // to make sure this is caught, move the current y down to
      // max_y (which is what out_gif_code checks).
      if (w == 0)
        g->cur_y = g->max_y;

      g->lflags = stbi__get8(s);

      if (g->lflags & 0x40) {
        g->step = 8 * g->line_size; // first interlaced spacing
        g->parse = 3;
      } else {
        g->step = g->line_size;
        g->parse = 0;
      }

      if (g->lflags & 0x80) {
        stbi__gif_parse_colortable(s, g->lpal, 2 << (g->lflags & 7),
                                   g->eflags & 0x01 ? g->transparent : -1);
        g->color_table = (stbi_uc *)g->lpal;
      } else if (g->flags & 0x80) {
        g->color_table = (stbi_uc *)g->pal;
      } else
        return stbi__errpuc("missing color table", "Corrupt GIF");

      o = stbi__process_gif_raster(s, g);
      if (!o)
        return NULL;

      // if this was the first frame,
      pcount = g->w * g->h;
      if (first_frame && (g->bgindex > 0)) {
        // if first frame, any pixel not drawn to gets the background color
        for (pi = 0; pi < pcount; ++pi) {
          if (g->history[pi] == 0) {
            g->pal[g->bgindex][3] =
                255; // just in case it was made transparent, undo that; It will
                     // be reset next frame if need be;
            memcpy(&g->out[pi * 4], &g->pal[g->bgindex], 4);
          }
        }
      }

      return o;
    }

    case 0x21: // Comment Extension.
    {
      int len;
      int ext = stbi__get8(s);
      if (ext == 0xF9) { // Graphic Control Extension.
        len = stbi__get8(s);
        if (len == 4) {
          g->eflags = stbi__get8(s);
          g->delay =
              10 * stbi__get16le(
                       s); // delay - 1/100th of a second, saving as 1/1000ths.

          // unset old transparent
          if (g->transparent >= 0) {
            g->pal[g->transparent][3] = 255;
          }
          if (g->eflags & 0x01) {
            g->transparent = stbi__get8(s);
            if (g->transparent >= 0) {
              g->pal[g->transparent][3] = 0;
            }
          } else {
            // don't need transparent
            stbi__skip(s, 1);
            g->transparent = -1;
          }
        } else {
          stbi__skip(s, len);
          break;
        }
      }
      while ((len = stbi__get8(s)) != 0) {
        stbi__skip(s, len);
      }
      break;
    }

    case 0x3B:             // gif stream termination code
      return (stbi_uc *)s; // using '1' causes warning on some compilers

    default:
      return stbi__errpuc("unknown code", "Corrupt GIF");
    }
  }
}

static void *stbi__load_gif_main(stbi__context *s, int **delays, int *x, int *y,
                                 int *z, int *comp, int req_comp) {
  if (stbi__gif_test(s)) {
    int layers = 0;
    stbi_uc *u = 0;
    stbi_uc *out = 0;
    stbi_uc *two_back = 0;
    stbi__gif g;
    int stride;
    memset(&g, 0, sizeof(g));
    if (delays) {
      *delays = 0;
    }

    do {
      u = stbi__gif_load_next(s, &g, comp, req_comp, two_back);
      if (u == (stbi_uc *)s)
        u = 0; // end of animated gif marker

      if (u) {
        *x = g.w;
        *y = g.h;
        ++layers;
        stride = g.w * g.h * 4;

        if (out) {
          out = (stbi_uc *)STBI_REALLOC(out, layers * stride);
          if (delays) {
            *delays = (int *)STBI_REALLOC(*delays, sizeof(int) * layers);
          }
        } else {
          out = (stbi_uc *)stbi__malloc(layers * stride);
          if (delays) {
            *delays = (int *)stbi__malloc(layers * sizeof(int));
          }
        }
        memcpy(out + ((layers - 1) * stride), u, stride);
        if (layers >= 2) {
          two_back = out - 2 * stride;
        }

        if (delays) {
          (*delays)[layers - 1U] = g.delay;
        }
      }
    } while (u != 0);

    // free temp buffer;
    STBI_FREE(g.out);
    STBI_FREE(g.history);
    STBI_FREE(g.background);

    // do the final conversion after loading everything;
    if (req_comp && req_comp != 4)
      out = stbi__convert_format(out, 4, req_comp, layers * g.w, g.h);

    *z = layers;
    return out;
  } else {
    return stbi__errpuc("not GIF", "Image was not as a gif type.");
  }
}

static void *stbi__gif_load(stbi__context *s, int *x, int *y, int *comp,
                            int req_comp, stbi__result_info *ri) {
  stbi_uc *u = 0;
  stbi__gif g;
  memset(&g, 0, sizeof(g));
  STBI_NOTUSED(ri);

  u = stbi__gif_load_next(s, &g, comp, req_comp, 0);
  if (u == (stbi_uc *)s)
    u = 0; // end of animated gif marker
  if (u) {
    *x = g.w;
    *y = g.h;

    // moved conversion to after successful load so that the same
    // can be done for multiple frames.
    if (req_comp && req_comp != 4)
      u = stbi__convert_format(u, 4, req_comp, g.w, g.h);
  } else if (g.out) {
    // if there was an error and we allocated an image buffer, free it!
    STBI_FREE(g.out);
  }

  // free buffers needed for multiple frame loading;
  STBI_FREE(g.history);
  STBI_FREE(g.background);

  return u;
}

static int stbi__gif_info(stbi__context *s, int *x, int *y, int *comp) {
  return stbi__gif_info_raw(s, x, y, comp);
}
#endif

// *************************************************************************************************
// Radiance RGBE HDR loader
// originally by Nicolas Schulz
#ifndef STBI_NO_HDR
static int stbi__hdr_test_core(stbi__context *s, const char *signature) {
  int i;
  for (i = 0; signature[i]; ++i)
    if (stbi__get8(s) != signature[i])
      return 0;
  stbi__rewind(s);
  return 1;
}

static int stbi__hdr_test(stbi__context *s) {
  int r = stbi__hdr_test_core(s, "#?RADIANCE\n");
  stbi__rewind(s);
  if (!r) {
    r = stbi__hdr_test_core(s, "#?RGBE\n");
    stbi__rewind(s);
  }
  return r;
}

#define STBI__HDR_BUFLEN 1024
static char *stbi__hdr_gettoken(stbi__context *z, char *buffer) {
  int len = 0;
  char c = '\0';

  c = (char)stbi__get8(z);

  while (!stbi__at_eof(z) && c != '\n') {
    buffer[len++] = c;
    if (len == STBI__HDR_BUFLEN - 1) {
      // flush to end of line
      while (!stbi__at_eof(z) && stbi__get8(z) != '\n')
        ;
      break;
    }
    c = (char)stbi__get8(z);
  }

  buffer[len] = 0;
  return buffer;
}

static void stbi__hdr_convert(float *output, stbi_uc *input, int req_comp) {
  if (input[3] != 0) {
    float f1;
    // Exponent
    f1 = (float)ldexp(1.0f, input[3] - (int)(128 + 8));
    if (req_comp <= 2)
      output[0] = (input[0] + input[1] + input[2]) * f1 / 3;
    else {
      output[0] = input[0] * f1;
      output[1] = input[1] * f1;
      output[2] = input[2] * f1;
    }
    if (req_comp == 2)
      output[1] = 1;
    if (req_comp == 4)
      output[3] = 1;
  } else {
    switch (req_comp) {
    case 4:
      output[3] = 1; /* fallthrough */
    case 3:
      output[0] = output[1] = output[2] = 0;
      break;
    case 2:
      output[1] = 1; /* fallthrough */
    case 1:
      output[0] = 0;
      break;
    }
  }
}

static float *stbi__hdr_load(stbi__context *s, int *x, int *y, int *comp,
                             int req_comp, stbi__result_info *ri) {
  char buffer[STBI__HDR_BUFLEN];
  char *token;
  int valid = 0;
  int width, height;
  stbi_uc *scanline;
  float *hdr_data;
  int len;
  unsigned char count, value;
  int i, j, k, c1, c2, z;
  const char *headerToken;
  STBI_NOTUSED(ri);

  // Check identifier
  headerToken = stbi__hdr_gettoken(s, buffer);
  if (strcmp(headerToken, "#?RADIANCE") != 0 &&
      strcmp(headerToken, "#?RGBE") != 0)
    return stbi__errpf("not HDR", "Corrupt HDR image");

  // Parse header
  for (;;) {
    token = stbi__hdr_gettoken(s, buffer);
    if (token[0] == 0)
      break;
    if (strcmp(token, "FORMAT=32-bit_rle_rgbe") == 0)
      valid = 1;
  }

  if (!valid)
    return stbi__errpf("unsupported format", "Unsupported HDR format");

  // Parse width and height
  // can't use sscanf() if we're not using stdio!
  token = stbi__hdr_gettoken(s, buffer);
  if (strncmp(token, "-Y ", 3))
    return stbi__errpf("unsupported data layout", "Unsupported HDR format");
  token += 3;
  height = (int)strtol(token, &token, 10);
  while (*token == ' ')
    ++token;
  if (strncmp(token, "+X ", 3))
    return stbi__errpf("unsupported data layout", "Unsupported HDR format");
  token += 3;
  width = (int)strtol(token, NULL, 10);

  *x = width;
  *y = height;

  if (comp)
    *comp = 3;
  if (req_comp == 0)
    req_comp = 3;

  if (!stbi__mad4sizes_valid(width, height, req_comp, sizeof(float), 0))
    return stbi__errpf("too large", "HDR image is too large");

  // Read data
  hdr_data =
      (float *)stbi__malloc_mad4(width, height, req_comp, sizeof(float), 0);
  if (!hdr_data)
    return stbi__errpf("outofmem", "Out of memory");

  // Load image data
  // image data is stored as some number of sca
  if (width < 8 || width >= 32768) {
    // Read flat data
    for (j = 0; j < height; ++j) {
      for (i = 0; i < width; ++i) {
        stbi_uc rgbe[4];
      main_decode_loop:
        stbi__getn(s, rgbe, 4);
        stbi__hdr_convert(hdr_data + j * width * req_comp + i * req_comp, rgbe,
                          req_comp);
      }
    }
  } else {
    // Read RLE-encoded data
    scanline = NULL;

    for (j = 0; j < height; ++j) {
      c1 = stbi__get8(s);
      c2 = stbi__get8(s);
      len = stbi__get8(s);
      if (c1 != 2 || c2 != 2 || (len & 0x80)) {
        // not run-length encoded, so we have to actually use THIS data as a
        // decoded pixel (note this can't be a valid pixel--one of RGB must be
        // >= 128)
        stbi_uc rgbe[4];
        rgbe[0] = (stbi_uc)c1;
        rgbe[1] = (stbi_uc)c2;
        rgbe[2] = (stbi_uc)len;
        rgbe[3] = (stbi_uc)stbi__get8(s);
        stbi__hdr_convert(hdr_data, rgbe, req_comp);
        i = 1;
        j = 0;
        STBI_FREE(scanline);
        goto main_decode_loop; // yes, this makes no sense
      }
      len <<= 8;
      len |= stbi__get8(s);
      if (len != width) {
        STBI_FREE(hdr_data);
        STBI_FREE(scanline);
        return stbi__errpf("invalid decoded scanline length", "corrupt HDR");
      }
      if (scanline == NULL) {
        scanline = (stbi_uc *)stbi__malloc_mad2(width, 4, 0);
        if (!scanline) {
          STBI_FREE(hdr_data);
          return stbi__errpf("outofmem", "Out of memory");
        }
      }

      for (k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
        int nleft;
        i = 0;
        while ((nleft = width - i) > 0) {
          count = stbi__get8(s);
          if (count > 128) {
            // Run
            value = stbi__get8(s);
            count -= 128;
            if (count > nleft) {
              STBI_FREE(hdr_data);
              STBI_FREE(scanline);
              return stbi__errpf("corrupt", "bad RLE data in HDR");
            }
            for (z = 0; z < count; ++z)
              scanline[i++ * 4 + k] = value;
          } else {
            // Dump
            if (count > nleft) {
              STBI_FREE(hdr_data);
              STBI_FREE(scanline);
              return stbi__errpf("corrupt", "bad RLE data in HDR");
            }
            for (z = 0; z < count; ++z)
              scanline[i++ * 4 + k] = stbi__get8(s);
          }
        }
      }
      for (i = 0; i < width; ++i)
        stbi__hdr_convert(hdr_data + (j * width + i) * req_comp,
                          scanline + i * 4, req_comp);
    }
    if (scanline)
      STBI_FREE(scanline);
  }

  return hdr_data;
}

static int stbi__hdr_info(stbi__context *s, int *x, int *y, int *comp) {
  char buffer[STBI__HDR_BUFLEN];
  char *token;
  int valid = 0;
  int dummy;

  if (!x)
    x = &dummy;
  if (!y)
    y = &dummy;
  if (!comp)
    comp = &dummy;

  if (stbi__hdr_test(s) == 0) {
    stbi__rewind(s);
    return 0;
  }

  for (;;) {
    token = stbi__hdr_gettoken(s, buffer);
    if (token[0] == 0)
      break;
    if (strcmp(token, "FORMAT=32-bit_rle_rgbe") == 0)
      valid = 1;
  }

  if (!valid) {
    stbi__rewind(s);
    return 0;
  }
  token = stbi__hdr_gettoken(s, buffer);
  if (strncmp(token, "-Y ", 3)) {
    stbi__rewind(s);
    return 0;
  }
  token += 3;
  *y = (int)strtol(token, &token, 10);
  while (*token == ' ')
    ++token;
  if (strncmp(token, "+X ", 3)) {
    stbi__rewind(s);
    return 0;
  }
  token += 3;
  *x = (int)strtol(token, NULL, 10);
  *comp = 3;
  return 1;
}
#endif // STBI_NO_HDR

#ifndef STBI_NO_BMP
static int stbi__bmp_info(stbi__context *s, int *x, int *y, int *comp) {
  void *p;
  stbi__bmp_data info;

  info.all_a = 255;
  p = stbi__bmp_parse_header(s, &info);
  stbi__rewind(s);
  if (p == NULL)
    return 0;
  if (x)
    *x = s->img_x;
  if (y)
    *y = s->img_y;
  if (comp) {
    if (info.bpp == 24 && info.ma == 0xff000000)
      *comp = 3;
    else
      *comp = info.ma ? 4 : 3;
  }
  return 1;
}
#endif

#ifndef STBI_NO_PSD
static int stbi__psd_info(stbi__context *s, int *x, int *y, int *comp) {
  int channelCount, dummy, depth;
  if (!x)
    x = &dummy;
  if (!y)
    y = &dummy;
  if (!comp)
    comp = &dummy;
  if (stbi__get32be(s) != 0x38425053) {
    stbi__rewind(s);
    return 0;
  }
  if (stbi__get16be(s) != 1) {
    stbi__rewind(s);
    return 0;
  }
  stbi__skip(s, 6);
  channelCount = stbi__get16be(s);
  if (channelCount < 0 || channelCount > 16) {
    stbi__rewind(s);
    return 0;
  }
  *y = stbi__get32be(s);
  *x = stbi__get32be(s);
  depth = stbi__get16be(s);
  if (depth != 8 && depth != 16) {
    stbi__rewind(s);
    return 0;
  }
  if (stbi__get16be(s) != 3) {
    stbi__rewind(s);
    return 0;
  }
  *comp = 4;
  return 1;
}

static int stbi__psd_is16(stbi__context *s) {
  int channelCount, depth;
  if (stbi__get32be(s) != 0x38425053) {
    stbi__rewind(s);
    return 0;
  }
  if (stbi__get16be(s) != 1) {
    stbi__rewind(s);
    return 0;
  }
  stbi__skip(s, 6);
  channelCount = stbi__get16be(s);
  if (channelCount < 0 || channelCount > 16) {
    stbi__rewind(s);
    return 0;
  }
  (void)stbi__get32be(s);
  (void)stbi__get32be(s);
  depth = stbi__get16be(s);
  if (depth != 16) {
    stbi__rewind(s);
    return 0;
  }
  return 1;
}
#endif

#ifndef STBI_NO_PIC
static int stbi__pic_info(stbi__context *s, int *x, int *y, int *comp) {
  int act_comp = 0, num_packets = 0, chained, dummy;
  stbi__pic_packet packets[10];

  if (!x)
    x = &dummy;
  if (!y)
    y = &dummy;
  if (!comp)
    comp = &dummy;

  if (!stbi__pic_is4(s, "\x53\x80\xF6\x34")) {
    stbi__rewind(s);
    return 0;
  }

  stbi__skip(s, 88);

  *x = stbi__get16be(s);
  *y = stbi__get16be(s);
  if (stbi__at_eof(s)) {
    stbi__rewind(s);
    return 0;
  }
  if ((*x) != 0 && (1 << 28) / (*x) < (*y)) {
    stbi__rewind(s);
    return 0;
  }

  stbi__skip(s, 8);

  do {
    stbi__pic_packet *packet;

    if (num_packets == sizeof(packets) / sizeof(packets[0]))
      return 0;

    packet = &packets[num_packets++];
    chained = stbi__get8(s);
    packet->size = stbi__get8(s);
    packet->type = stbi__get8(s);
    packet->channel = stbi__get8(s);
    act_comp |= packet->channel;

    if (stbi__at_eof(s)) {
      stbi__rewind(s);
      return 0;
    }
    if (packet->size != 8) {
      stbi__rewind(s);
      return 0;
    }
  } while (chained);

  *comp = (act_comp & 0x10 ? 4 : 3);

  return 1;
}
#endif

// *************************************************************************************************
// Portable Gray Map and Portable Pixel Map loader
// by Ken Miller
//
// PGM: http://netpbm.sourceforge.net/doc/pgm.html
// PPM: http://netpbm.sourceforge.net/doc/ppm.html
//
// Known limitations:
//    Does not support comments in the header section
//    Does not support ASCII image data (formats P2 and P3)
//    Does not support 16-bit-per-channel

#ifndef STBI_NO_PNM

static int stbi__pnm_test(stbi__context *s) {
  char p, t;
  p = (char)stbi__get8(s);
  t = (char)stbi__get8(s);
  if (p != 'P' || (t != '5' && t != '6')) {
    stbi__rewind(s);
    return 0;
  }
  return 1;
}

static void *stbi__pnm_load(stbi__context *s, int *x, int *y, int *comp,
                            int req_comp, stbi__result_info *ri) {
  stbi_uc *out;
  STBI_NOTUSED(ri);

  if (!stbi__pnm_info(s, (int *)&s->img_x, (int *)&s->img_y, (int *)&s->img_n))
    return 0;

  *x = s->img_x;
  *y = s->img_y;
  if (comp)
    *comp = s->img_n;

  if (!stbi__mad3sizes_valid(s->img_n, s->img_x, s->img_y, 0))
    return stbi__errpuc("too large", "PNM too large");

  out = (stbi_uc *)stbi__malloc_mad3(s->img_n, s->img_x, s->img_y, 0);
  if (!out)
    return stbi__errpuc("outofmem", "Out of memory");
  stbi__getn(s, out, s->img_n * s->img_x * s->img_y);

  if (req_comp && req_comp != s->img_n) {
    out = stbi__convert_format(out, s->img_n, req_comp, s->img_x, s->img_y);
    if (out == NULL)
      return out; // stbi__convert_format frees input on failure
  }
  return out;
}

static int stbi__pnm_isspace(char c) {
  return c == ' ' || c == '\t' || c == '\n' || c == '\v' || c == '\f' ||
         c == '\r';
}

static void stbi__pnm_skip_whitespace(stbi__context *s, char *c) {
  for (;;) {
    while (!stbi__at_eof(s) && stbi__pnm_isspace(*c))
      *c = (char)stbi__get8(s);

    if (stbi__at_eof(s) || *c != '#')
      break;

    while (!stbi__at_eof(s) && *c != '\n' && *c != '\r')
      *c = (char)stbi__get8(s);
  }
}

static int stbi__pnm_isdigit(char c) { return c >= '0' && c <= '9'; }

static int stbi__pnm_getinteger(stbi__context *s, char *c) {
  int value = 0;

  while (!stbi__at_eof(s) && stbi__pnm_isdigit(*c)) {
    value = value * 10 + (*c - '0');
    *c = (char)stbi__get8(s);
  }

  return value;
}

static int stbi__pnm_info(stbi__context *s, int *x, int *y, int *comp) {
  int maxv, dummy;
  char c, p, t;

  if (!x)
    x = &dummy;
  if (!y)
    y = &dummy;
  if (!comp)
    comp = &dummy;

  stbi__rewind(s);

  // Get identifier
  p = (char)stbi__get8(s);
  t = (char)stbi__get8(s);
  if (p != 'P' || (t != '5' && t != '6')) {
    stbi__rewind(s);
    return 0;
  }

  *comp =
      (t == '6') ? 3 : 1; // '5' is 1-component .pgm; '6' is 3-component .ppm

  c = (char)stbi__get8(s);
  stbi__pnm_skip_whitespace(s, &c);

  *x = stbi__pnm_getinteger(s, &c); // read width
  stbi__pnm_skip_whitespace(s, &c);

  *y = stbi__pnm_getinteger(s, &c); // read height
  stbi__pnm_skip_whitespace(s, &c);

  maxv = stbi__pnm_getinteger(s, &c); // read max value

  if (maxv > 255)
    return stbi__err("max value > 255", "PPM image not 8-bit");
  else
    return 1;
}
#endif

static int stbi__info_main(stbi__context *s, int *x, int *y, int *comp) {
#ifndef STBI_NO_JPEG
  if (stbi__jpeg_info(s, x, y, comp))
    return 1;
#endif

#ifndef STBI_NO_PNG
  if (stbi__png_info(s, x, y, comp))
    return 1;
#endif

#ifndef STBI_NO_GIF
  if (stbi__gif_info(s, x, y, comp))
    return 1;
#endif

#ifndef STBI_NO_BMP
  if (stbi__bmp_info(s, x, y, comp))
    return 1;
#endif

#ifndef STBI_NO_PSD
  if (stbi__psd_info(s, x, y, comp))
    return 1;
#endif

#ifndef STBI_NO_PIC
  if (stbi__pic_info(s, x, y, comp))
    return 1;
#endif

#ifndef STBI_NO_PNM
  if (stbi__pnm_info(s, x, y, comp))
    return 1;
#endif

#ifndef STBI_NO_HDR
  if (stbi__hdr_info(s, x, y, comp))
    return 1;
#endif

    // test tga last because it's a crappy test!
#ifndef STBI_NO_TGA
  if (stbi__tga_info(s, x, y, comp))
    return 1;
#endif
  return stbi__err("unknown image type",
                   "Image not of any known type, or corrupt");
}

static int stbi__is_16_main(stbi__context *s) {
#ifndef STBI_NO_PNG
  if (stbi__png_is16(s))
    return 1;
#endif

#ifndef STBI_NO_PSD
  if (stbi__psd_is16(s))
    return 1;
#endif

  return 0;
}

#ifndef STBI_NO_STDIO
STBIDEF int stbi_info(char const *filename, int *x, int *y, int *comp) {
  FILE *f = stbi__fopen(filename, "rb");
  int result;
  if (!f)
    return stbi__err("can't fopen", "Unable to open file");
  result = stbi_info_from_file(f, x, y, comp);
  fclose(f);
  return result;
}

STBIDEF int stbi_info_from_file(FILE *f, int *x, int *y, int *comp) {
  int r;
  stbi__context s;
  long pos = ftell(f);
  stbi__start_file(&s, f);
  r = stbi__info_main(&s, x, y, comp);
  fseek(f, pos, SEEK_SET);
  return r;
}

STBIDEF int stbi_is_16_bit(char const *filename) {
  FILE *f = stbi__fopen(filename, "rb");
  int result;
  if (!f)
    return stbi__err("can't fopen", "Unable to open file");
  result = stbi_is_16_bit_from_file(f);
  fclose(f);
  return result;
}

STBIDEF int stbi_is_16_bit_from_file(FILE *f) {
  int r;
  stbi__context s;
  long pos = ftell(f);
  stbi__start_file(&s, f);
  r = stbi__is_16_main(&s);
  fseek(f, pos, SEEK_SET);
  return r;
}
#endif // !STBI_NO_STDIO

STBIDEF int stbi_info_from_memory(stbi_uc const *buffer, int len, int *x,
                                  int *y, int *comp) {
  stbi__context s;
  stbi__start_mem(&s, buffer, len);
  return stbi__info_main(&s, x, y, comp);
}

STBIDEF int stbi_info_from_callbacks(stbi_io_callbacks const *c, void *user,
                                     int *x, int *y, int *comp) {
  stbi__context s;
  stbi__start_callbacks(&s, (stbi_io_callbacks *)c, user);
  return stbi__info_main(&s, x, y, comp);
}

STBIDEF int stbi_is_16_bit_from_memory(stbi_uc const *buffer, int len) {
  stbi__context s;
  stbi__start_mem(&s, buffer, len);
  return stbi__is_16_main(&s);
}

STBIDEF int stbi_is_16_bit_from_callbacks(stbi_io_callbacks const *c,
                                          void *user) {
  stbi__context s;
  stbi__start_callbacks(&s, (stbi_io_callbacks *)c, user);
  return stbi__is_16_main(&s);
}

#endif // STB_IMAGE_IMPLEMENTATION

   now 2.12  (2016-04-02) fix typo in 2.11 PSD fix that caused crashes 2.11
   (2016-04-02) allocate large structures on the stack remove white matting for
   transparent PSD fix reported channel count for PNG & BMP re-enable SSE2 in
   non-gcc 64-bit support RGB-formatted JPEG read 16-bit PNGs (only as 8-bit)
          2.10  (2016-01-22) avoid warning introduced in 2.09 by
   STBI_REALLOC_SIZED 2.09  (2016-01-16) allow comments in PNM files

// src/editor/EditorExtension.cpp
#include "app/EditorExtension.h"
#include <GLFW/glfw3.h>
#include "core/Application.h"
#include "core/Input.h"
#include "core/scene/Scene.h"
#include "imgui.h"
#include "ui/Editor.h"
#include "ui/EditorContext.h"
#include "ui/backends/ImGuiBackend.h"
#include "ui/modules/BasicToolsModule.h"

EditorExtension::~EditorExtension() noexcept = default;

void EditorExtension::OnInit(engine::Application& app) {
  m_imgui = std::make_unique<ui::ImGuiBackend>();
  m_imgui->Init(static_cast<GLFWwindow*>(app.GetNativeWindow()), "#version 330");

  m_editor = std::make_unique<ui::Editor>();
  m_editor->RegisterModule(std::make_unique<ui::BasicToolsModule>());
    ui::EditorContext ec{};
  ec.m_app    = &app;
  ec.m_window = app.GetNativeWindow();
  ec.m_scene  = &app.GetScene();
  m_editor->SetActiveTool(ui::ToolType::PLACE_ON_GROUND, ec);
}

void EditorExtension::OnBeginUI(engine::Application& /*app*/, ui::EditorContext& ctx) {
  // 1) начинаем кадр ImGui
  m_imgui->BeginFrame();
  m_imgui->DrawDockspace();

  // 2) Получаем актуальный viewport из ImGui
  ImGuiViewport* vp = ImGui::GetMainViewport();
  ctx.vpX = static_cast<int>(vp->WorkPos.x);
  ctx.vpY = static_cast<int>(vp->WorkPos.y);
  ctx.vpW = static_cast<int>(vp->WorkSize.x);
  ctx.vpH = static_cast<int>(vp->WorkSize.y);

  // 3) HiDPI scale
  int fbw = 0, fbh = 0, ww = 0, wh = 0;
  glfwGetFramebufferSize(ctx.m_window, &fbw, &fbh);
  glfwGetWindowSize(ctx.m_window, &ww, &wh);
  ctx.m_vpScaleX = (ww > 0) ? static_cast<float>(fbw) / static_cast<float>(ww) : 1.f;
  ctx.m_vpScaleY = (wh > 0) ? static_cast<float>(fbh) / static_cast<float>(wh) : 1.f;

  // 4) Размеры вьюпорта для проекций (в framebuffer-пикселях)
  ctx.m_viewportW = static_cast<int>(ctx.vpW * ctx.m_vpScaleX);
  ctx.m_viewportH = static_cast<int>(ctx.vpH * ctx.m_vpScaleY);

  // 5) Обновляем матрицы из сцены с ПРАВИЛЬНЫМИ размерами
  ctx.m_view = ctx.m_scene->GetViewMatrix();
  ctx.m_proj = ctx.m_scene->GetProjMatrix(ctx.m_viewportW, ctx.m_viewportH);

  // 6) Сообщаем сцене актуальные параметры viewport
  ctx.m_scene->SetViewportRect(ctx.vpX, ctx.vpY, ctx.vpW, ctx.vpH);
  ctx.m_scene->SetViewportScale(ctx.m_vpScaleX, ctx.m_vpScaleY);

  // 7) Рендер UI редактора
  m_editor->DrawUI(ctx);
  
  // 8) Обновляем состояние захвата ввода
  const ImGuiIO& io = ImGui::GetIO();
  engine::InputSystem::Instance().SetUICapture(io.WantCaptureMouse, io.WantCaptureKeyboard);
  
  // 9) Обновляем активные инструменты
  m_editor->TickTools(ctx);
}


void EditorExtension::OnEndUI(engine::Application&, ui::EditorContext&) {
  // 3) завершаем кадр ImGui (Render + RenderDrawData + платформенные окна)
  m_imgui->EndFrame();
}

void EditorExtension::OnShutdown(engine::Application&) {
  m_editor.reset();  // сначала редактор
  if (m_imgui) {
    m_imgui->Shutdown();
  }
  m_imgui.reset();
}

===== FILE: ./src/configs/WindConfig.h =====
#pragma once
#include <glm/glm.hpp>
struct WindConfig {
    glm::vec3 direction = glm::vec3(1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f); // Направление ветра
    float strength = 10.0f;                              // Сила ветра (0-1)
    float gustiness = 0.3f;                             // Порывистость
    float change_speed = 0.1f;                          // Скорость изменения
    
    // Метод для получения текущего ветра с шумом
    glm::vec3 getCurrentWind(float time) const {
        glm::vec3 base_wind = glm::normalize(direction) * strength;
        
        float noise_x = sin(time * change_speed * 2.0f) * gustiness;
        float noise_z = cos(time * change_speed * 1.7f) * gustiness;
        
        return base_wind + glm::vec3(noise_x, 0.0f, noise_z);
    }
};

===== FILE: ./src/core/agent.h =====
#pragma once
#include <glm/glm.hpp>

#include "cuda_include.h"
enum AgentType {
    NORMAL = 0,
    BURNING = 1,   
    BURNED = 2
};

struct Float3 {
    float x, y, z;
    
    __host__ __device__ Float3() : x(0), y(0), z(0) {}
    __host__ __device__ Float3(float x, float y, float z) : x(x), y(y), z(z) {}
    __host__ __device__ static Float3 fromGlm(const glm::vec3& v) {
        return Float3(v.x, v.y, v.z);
    }
    
    __host__ __device__ glm::vec3 toGlm() const {
        return glm::vec3(x, y, z);
    }
    __host__ __device__ float& operator[](int i) { 
        return i == 0 ? x : (i == 1 ? y : z); 
    }
    __host__ __device__ float operator[](int i) const { 
        return i == 0 ? x : (i == 1 ? y : z); 
    }
};

struct FireCollider {
    Float3 bounds_min, bounds_max;
    Float3 heat_points[64];
    float fuels[64];
    float intensities[64];
    int point_count;
    
    __host__ __device__
    FireCollider() : point_count(0) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            bounds_min[i] = 0.0f;
            bounds_max[i] = 0.0f;
        }
    }
};

struct Agent {
    Float3 position;
    AgentType type;
    float intensity{};
    int object_id; 
    
    // Универсальный коллайдер для огня
    FireCollider fire_collider;
    
    __host__ __device__
    Agent() : position(), type(NORMAL), object_id(-1) {}
    
    __host__ __device__
    Agent(float x, float y, float z, AgentType type, int id) 
        : position(x, y, z), type(type), object_id(id) {}
    
    __host__ __device__
    bool isBurning() const { 
        for (int i = 0; i < fire_collider.point_count; i++) {
            if (fire_collider.intensities[i] > 0.1f) {
                return true;  
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
    
    __host__ __device__
    float getOverallIntensity() const {
        float max = 0.0f;
        for (int i = 0; i < fire_collider.point_count; i++) {
            if (fire_collider.intensities[i] > max) {
                max = fire_collider.intensities[i];
            }
        }
        return max;
    }
};

===== FILE: ./src/core/AgentManager.cc =====
#include "AgentManager.h"
#include <cuda_runtime.h>
#include <random>
#include <iostream>

AgentManager::AgentManager(int max_agents) : m_capacity(max_agents), m_count(0) {
    cudaMalloc(&m_agents, max_agents * sizeof(Agent));
}

AgentManager::~AgentManager() {
    cudaFree(m_agents);
}

Agent AgentManager::AddTree(int tree_id, float base_x, float base_z) {
    Agent tree;
    tree.type = NORMAL;
    tree.object_id = tree_id;
    tree.position = {base_x, 0.0f, base_z};
    
    setupTreeFireCollider(tree, base_x, base_z);
    
    AddAgent(tree);
    return tree;
}

void AgentManager::setupTreeFireCollider(Agent& tree, float base_x, float base_z) {
    tree.fire_collider.bounds_min.x = base_x - 2.0f;
    tree.fire_collider.bounds_min.y = 0.0f;         
    tree.fire_collider.bounds_min.z = base_z - 2.0f;
    
    tree.fire_collider.bounds_max.x = base_x + 2.0f;
    tree.fire_collider.bounds_max.y = 8.0f;         
    tree.fire_collider.bounds_max.z = base_z + 2.0f;
    
    generateTreeHeatPoints(tree.fire_collider, base_x, base_z);
}

void AgentManager::IgniteRandomPoint(int agent_index)
 {
    if (agent_index < 0 || agent_index >= m_count) return;
    Agent agent;
    cudaMemcpy(&agent, m_agents + agent_index, sizeof(Agent), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost);
    
    if (agent.fire_collider.point_count > 0) {
        int random_point = rand() % agent.fire_collider.point_count;
        agent.fire_collider.intensities[random_point] = 1.0f;
        cudaMemcpy(m_agents + agent_index, &agent, sizeof(Agent), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice);
    }
}

void AgentManager::generateTreeHeatPoints(FireCollider &collider, float base_x, float base_z)
{
    collider.point_count = 0;
    
    for (float height = 0.5f; height <= 8.0f; height += 0.8f) {
        collider.heat_points[collider.point_count].x = base_x;
        collider.heat_points[collider.point_count].y = height;
        collider.heat_points[collider.point_count].z = base_z;
        collider.fuels[collider.point_count] = 30.0f;
        collider.intensities[collider.point_count] = 0.0f;
        collider.point_count++;
    }
    
    float levels[] = {2.0f, 4.0f, 6.0f, 7.5f};
    float level_radii[] = {1.0f, 1.8f, 2.2f, 1.5f};
    int points_per_level[] = {8, 12, 16, 8};
    
    for (int level = 0; level < 4; level++) {
        float height = levels[level];
        float radius = level_radii[level];
        int points = points_per_level[level];
        
        for (int i = 0; i < points; i++) {
            float angle = (float)i / points * 360.0f;
            float rad = glm::radians(angle);
            
            collider.heat_points[collider.point_count].x = base_x + cos(rad) * radius;
            collider.heat_points[collider.point_count].y = height;
            collider.heat_points[collider.point_count].z = base_z + sin(rad) * radius;
            collider.fuels[collider.point_count] = 20.0f;
            collider.intensities[collider.point_count] = 0.0f;
            collider.point_count++;
            
            if (collider.point_count >= 64) break;
        }
        if (collider.point_count >= 64) break;
    }
    
    std::random_device rd;
    std::mt19937 gen(rd());
    std::uniform_real_distribution<float> dist_x(base_x - 2.0f, base_x + 2.0f);
    std::uniform_real_distribution<float> dist_z(base_z - 2.0f, base_z + 2.0f);
    std::uniform_real_distribution<float> dist_y(1.0f, 7.0f);
    
    while (collider.point_count < 50 && collider.point_count < 64) {
        collider.heat_points[collider.point_count].x = dist_x(gen);
        collider.heat_points[collider.point_count].y = dist_y(gen);
        collider.heat_points[collider.point_count].z = dist_z(gen);
        collider.fuels[collider.point_count] = 15.0f;
        collider.intensities[collider.point_count] = 0.0f;
        collider.point_count++;
    }
}

void AgentManager::AddFire(float x, float z, float intensity) {
  AddFireAt(Float3{x, 0.0f, z}, intensity);
}

void AgentManager::AddFireAt(const Float3& world, float intensity) {
  if (m_count >= m_capacity) return;

  Agent fire{};
  fire.type = BURNING;
  fire.object_id = -1;
  fire.position = world;

  fire.fire_collider.point_count = 1;
  fire.fire_collider.heat_points[0] = world;   // мировая точка источника
  fire.fire_collider.fuels[0] = 100.0f;
  fire.fire_collider.intensities[0] = intensity;

  fire.fire_collider.bounds_min = Float3(world.x - 0.25f, world.y - 0.25f, world.z - 0.25f);
  fire.fire_collider.bounds_max = Float3(world.x + 0.25f, world.y + 0.25f, world.z + 0.25f);

  AddAgent(fire);
}

void AgentManager::setupFireSourceCollider(Agent& fire, float x, float y) {
    fire.fire_collider.bounds_min.x = x - 0.5f;
    fire.fire_collider.bounds_min.y = 0.0f;  
    fire.fire_collider.bounds_min.z = y - 0.5f;
    
    fire.fire_collider.bounds_max.x = x + 0.5f;
    fire.fire_collider.bounds_max.y = 2.0f;
    fire.fire_collider.bounds_max.z = y + 0.5f;
    
    fire.fire_collider.point_count = 1;
    fire.fire_collider.heat_points[0].x = x;
    fire.fire_collider.heat_points[0].y = 1.0f;
    fire.fire_collider.heat_points[0].z = y;
    fire.fire_collider.fuels[0] = 50.0f;
    fire.fire_collider.intensities[0] = 0.0f;
}

void AgentManager::AddAgent(const Agent &agent) {
    if (m_count >= m_capacity) {
        std::cerr << "AgentManager: capacity exceeded!" << std::endl;
        return;
    }
    
    cudaMemcpy(m_agents + m_count, &agent, sizeof(Agent), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice);
    m_count++;
}
void AgentManager::Clear() {
    m_count = 0;
    cudaMemset(m_agents, 0, m_capacity * sizeof(Agent));
}
Agent AgentManager::CreateAgent(AgentType type, Float3 position, const AgentComponents& components) {
    Agent agent;
    agent.type = type;
    agent.position = position;
    agent.object_id = components.object_id;
    agent.intensity = components.intencity;
    
    agent.fire_collider.bounds_min = components.collider_bounds_min;
    agent.fire_collider.bounds_max = components.collider_bounds_max;
    generateTreeHeatPoints(agent.fire_collider, position.x, position.z);
    AddAgent(agent);
    return agent;
}

bool AgentManager::RemoveAgentAt(int idx, int* outFrom, int* outTo) {
  if (idx < 0 || (size_t)idx >= m_count) return false;
  const int last = (int)m_count - 1;
  if (outFrom) *outFrom = -1;
  if (outTo)   *outTo   = -1;

  if (idx != last) {
    // копируем последнего агента на место удаляемого
    cudaMemcpy(m_agents + idx, m_agents + last,
               sizeof(Agent), cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice);
    if (outFrom) *outFrom = last;
    if (outTo)   *outTo   = idx;
  }
  // просто уменьшаем "логическое" количество
  --m_count;
  // (опционально) cudaGetLastError проверка
  return true;
}

// Application.cc

#ifndef GLFW_INCLUDE_NONE

namespace engine {
Application::Application(int width, int height, const char *title)
    : m_last_frame_time(static_cast<float>(glfwGetTime())), m_width(width),
      m_height(height) {
  // Создание окна/GL
  m_window = std::make_unique<Window>(width, height, std::string(title));
  InitGL(); 

  // Сцена
  m_scene = std::make_unique<Scene>();
  m_scene->Init();
}

engine::Application::~Application() = default; 

void Application::AddExtension(std::unique_ptr<IAppExtension> ext) {
  m_extensions.push_back(std::move(ext));
}

void Application::Run() {
  for (auto& e : m_extensions) e->OnInit(*this);

  while (!ShouldClose()) {
    TickCore();

    // Собираем контекст на кадр (размеры, матрицы и т.п.)
    ui::EditorContext ctx{};
    ctx.m_editor    = &m_editor; 
    ctx.m_app      = this;  
    ctx.m_window    = GetNativeWindow();
    ctx.m_scene     = m_scene.get();
    ctx.m_viewportW = GetViewportWidth();
    ctx.m_viewportH = GetViewportHeight();
    ctx.m_view      = m_scene->GetViewMatrix();
    ctx.m_proj      = m_scene->GetProjMatrix(ctx.m_viewportW, ctx.m_viewportH);

    // === ВАЖНО: сначала начинаем UI-кадр (NewFrame + построение окон) ===
    for (auto& e : m_extensions) e->OnBeginUI(*this, ctx);
    // Теперь ImGui::GetIO().WantCaptureMouse/Keyboard — АКТУАЛЬНЫЕ
    UpdateScene();
    RenderScene();

    // Завершаем UI (Render + RenderDrawData)
    for (auto& e : m_extensions) e->OnEndUI(*this, ctx);

    SwapBuffers();
  }

  for (auto& e : m_extensions) e->OnShutdown(*this);
}


void Application::InitGL() {
  // активировать GL-контекст окна (если нужно), инициализировать glad
  auto *win = static_cast<GLFWwindow *>(GetNativeWindow());
  glfwMakeContextCurrent(win);

  if (gladLoadGLLoader((GLADloadproc)glfwGetProcAddress) == 0) {
    throw std::runtime_error("Failed to initialize GLAD");
  }
  glViewport(0, 0, m_width, m_height);
}

void Application::TickCore() {
  // dt
  auto now = static_cast<float>(glfwGetTime());
  m_dt = now - m_last_frame_time;
  m_last_frame_time = now;

  // события окна/инпут
  m_window->PollEvents();
}

void Application::UpdateScene() { m_scene->Update(m_dt); }

void Application::RenderScene() { m_scene->Render(); }

void Application::SwapBuffers() { m_window->SwapBuffers(); }

bool Application::ShouldClose() const { return m_window->ShouldClose(); }

GLFWwindow* engine::Application::GetNativeWindow() const {
  return m_window->GetWindow();
}

int Application::GetViewportWidth() const { return m_width; }
int Application::GetViewportHeight() const { return m_height; }
float Application::GetDeltaTime() const { return m_dt; }
Scene &Application::GetScene() { return *m_scene; }

bool Application::SaveScene(const std::string& path) {
    if (!m_serializer) {
        m_serializer = std::make_unique<data::SceneSerializer>(m_scene);
    }
    return m_serializer->Serialize(path);
}

void Application::LoadScene(const std::string& path) {
    if (!m_serializer) {
        m_serializer = std::make_unique<data::SceneSerializer>(
           m_scene);
    }
    m_serializer->Deserialize(path);
}
} // namespace engine

#include "Input.h"

void engine::InputSystem::Update() {
  m_previousKeyState       = m_currentKeyState;
  m_prevMouseButtonState   = m_mouseButtonState;

  m_mouseDelta   = glm::vec2(0.0f, 0.0f);
}

bool engine::InputSystem::GetKey(KeyCode key, InputState state) const {
  const bool currentIt  = (m_currentKeyState.count(key) != 0U)  ? m_currentKeyState.at(key)  : false;
  const bool previous = (m_previousKeyState.count(key) != 0U) ? m_previousKeyState.at(key) : false;

  switch (state) {
    case InputState::Held:     return currentIt;
    case InputState::Pressed:  return  currentIt && !previous;
    case InputState::Released: return !currentIt &&  previous;
  }
  return false;
}
void engine::InputSystem::SetMousePosition(float x, float y) {
  glm::vec2 newPos(x, y);
  m_mouseDelta     += (newPos - m_mousePosition); // накапливаем за кадр
  m_mousePosition   = newPos;
}

void engine::InputSystem::SetMouseButtonState(MouseButton button, bool pressed) {
  m_mouseButtonState[button] = pressed;
}


bool engine::InputSystem::GetMouseButton(MouseButton button, InputState state) const {
  const bool currentIt  = m_mouseButtonState.count(button)   ? m_mouseButtonState.at(button)   : false;
  const bool previousIt = m_prevMouseButtonState.count(button)? m_prevMouseButtonState.at(button): false;

  switch (state) {
    case InputState::Held:     return currentIt;
    case InputState::Pressed:  return  currentIt && !previousIt;
    case InputState::Released: return !currentIt &&  previousIt;
  }
  return false;
}
void engine::InputSystem::SetKeyState(KeyCode key, bool pressed)
{
    m_currentKeyState[key] = pressed;
}

===== FILE: ./src/core/scene/Camera.h =====
#pragma once
#include <glm/glm.hpp>
#include <glm/gtc/matrix_transform.hpp>
#define YAW -90.0f
#define PITCH -40.0f
#define SPEED 50.0f
#define SENSITIVITY 0.1f
#define ZOOM 45.0f
namespace engine {

enum Camera_Movement { FORWARD, BACKWARD, LEFT, RIGHT };

class Camera {
   public:
    Camera(glm::vec3 position = glm::vec3(0.0f, 0.0f, -3.0f), glm::vec3 up = glm::vec3(0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f),
           float yaw = YAW, float pitch = PITCH)
        : m_front(glm::vec3(0.0f, 0.0f, 1.0f)),
          m_movementSpeed(SPEED),
          m_mouseSensitivity(SENSITIVITY),
          m_zoom(ZOOM) {
        m_position = position;
        m_worldUp = up;
        m_yaw = yaw;
        m_pitch = pitch;
        updateCameraVectors();
    }

    glm::mat4 GetViewMatrix() { return glm::lookAt(m_position, m_position + m_front, m_up); }

    void ProcessKeyboard(Camera_Movement direction, float deltaTime) {
        float velocity = m_movementSpeed * deltaTime;
        if (direction == FORWARD) m_position += m_front * velocity;
        if (direction == BACKWARD) m_position -= m_front * velocity;
        if (direction == LEFT) m_position -= m_right * velocity;
        if (direction == RIGHT) m_position += m_right * velocity;
    }

    void ProcessMouseMovement(float xoffset, float yoffset, bool constrainPitch = true) {
        xoffset *= m_mouseSensitivity;
        yoffset *= m_mouseSensitivity;

        m_yaw += xoffset;
        m_pitch -= yoffset;

        if (constrainPitch) {
            if (m_pitch > 89.0f) m_pitch = 89.0f;
            if (m_pitch < -89.0f) m_pitch = -89.0f;
        }

        updateCameraVectors();
    }

    void updateCameraVectors() {
        // calculate the new Front vector
        glm::vec3 front;
        front.x = cos(m_yaw * (M_PI / 180.0)) * cos(m_pitch * (M_PI / 180.0));
        front.y = sin(m_pitch * (M_PI / 180.0));
        front.z = sin(m_yaw * (M_PI / 180.0)) * cos(m_pitch * (M_PI / 180.0));
           if (front.length() > 0) {
        m_front = glm::normalize(front);
    }

    // also re-calculate the Right and Up vector
    m_right = glm::normalize(glm::cross(m_front, m_worldUp));
    m_up = glm::normalize(glm::cross(m_right, m_front));
    }

    void ProcessMouseScroll(float yoffset) {
        m_zoom += (float)yoffset;
        if (m_zoom < 1.0f) m_zoom = 1.0f;
        if (m_zoom > 45.0f) m_zoom = 45.0f;
    }

    float GetZoom() const { return m_zoom; }
    glm::vec3 GetPosition() const {return m_position;}
   private:
    glm::vec3 m_position;
    glm::vec3 m_front;
    glm::vec3 m_up;
    glm::vec3 m_right;
    glm::vec3 m_worldUp;
    // euler Angles
    float m_yaw;
    float m_pitch;
    // camera options
    float m_movementSpeed;
    float m_mouseSensitivity;
    float m_zoom;
};
}


===== FILE: ./src/core/scene/Components.h =====
#pragma once
#define GLM_ENABLE_EXPERIMENTAL
#include <glm/glm.hpp>
#include <glm/gtc/matrix_transform.hpp>
#include <glm/gtx/quaternion.hpp>
namespace engine {

struct TransformComponent {
  glm::vec3 position;
  glm::vec3 rotation = {0.0, 0.0, 0.0};
  glm::vec3 scale = {1.0, 1.0, 1.0};

  TransformComponent() = default;
  TransformComponent(const glm::vec3 &pos) : position(pos) {}
  TransformComponent(const TransformComponent &other) = default;

  glm::mat4 GetTransform() const {
    glm::vec3 rotationRad = glm::radians(rotation);
    auto rot = glm::toMat4(glm::quat(rotationRad));
    auto trans = glm::translate(glm::mat4(1.0f), position);
    auto scl = glm::scale(glm::mat4(1.0f), scale);
    return trans * rot * scl;
  }
};
}

struct Renderable {
    glm::vec3 color{1.0f};
};

Scene::Scene() : m_agentManager(1000000), m_camera(glm::vec3(500.0F, 100.0F, 600.0F)) {}

void Scene::Init() {
  m_terrain = std::make_unique<Terrain>();
  TerrainGenerationSettings s;
  s.width = 256;
  s.depth = 256;
  s.scale = 2.0F;
  s.maxHeight = 40.0F;
  s.seed = 200;

  m_terrain->GenerateRandom(s);
  GetPrefabSystem().LoadAllFromDirectory("res/prefabs");
  m_renderer.Init();
  Generate();
}

void Scene::GenerateTerrain(const TerrainGenerationSettings& s) {
  m_terrain->GenerateRandom(s);
}

void Scene::EnsureModelsForPrefab(const std::string& id, const engine::data::AgentPrefab& prefab) {
  if (m_objectModels.Find(id)) {
    return;
  }

  const std::string& path = prefab.m_modelPath;
  if (path.empty()) {
    std::cerr << "[Scene] prefab '" << id << "' has empty model_path\n";
    return;
  }

  // Если у тебя нет отдельных путей для normal/burning/burned — грузим одну и
  // ту же модель.
  LoadObjectModels(id,
                   path,  // normal
                   path,  // burning
                   path   // burned
  );
}

void Scene::Update(float dt) {
  auto startTime = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();

  m_windTime += dt;

  auto simStart = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
  if (!m_sceneObjects.Empty()) {
    SimulationStep(m_agentManager.getDeviceAgents(), m_agentManager.getAgentCount(), dt,
                   m_windConfig.getCurrentWind(m_windTime));
  }
  auto simTime = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
  //  std::cout << "sim time" <<
  //  std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(simTime -
  //  startTime).count() << std::endl;

  const bool UI_MOUSE = engine::InputSystem::Instance().UIMouseCaptured();
  const bool UI_KBD = engine::InputSystem::Instance().UIKeyboardCaptured();

  // 2) WASD — только если UI не держит клавиатуру
  if (!UI_KBD) {
    if (engine::InputSystem::Instance().GetKey(engine::KeyCode::W)) {
      m_camera.ProcessKeyboard(FORWARD, dt);
    }
    if (engine::InputSystem::Instance().GetKey(engine::KeyCode::S)) {
      m_camera.ProcessKeyboard(BACKWARD, dt);
    }
    if (engine::InputSystem::Instance().GetKey(engine::KeyCode::D)) {
      m_camera.ProcessKeyboard(RIGHT, dt);
    }
    if (engine::InputSystem::Instance().GetKey(engine::KeyCode::A)) {
      m_camera.ProcessKeyboard(LEFT, dt);
    }
  }

  // 3) Поворот камеры — только если UI не держит мышь И зажат RMB
  const glm::vec2 DELTA = engine::InputSystem::Instance().GetMouseDelta();
  if (!UI_MOUSE && engine::InputSystem::Instance().GetMouseButton(engine::MouseButton::Right,
                                                                  InputState::Held)) {
    if (DELTA.x != 0.F || DELTA.y != 0.F) {
      m_camera.ProcessMouseMovement(DELTA.x, DELTA.y);
    }
  }

  // 5) Зум — только если UI не держит мышь/скролл
  if (!UI_MOUSE) {
    const float SCROLL_Y = engine::InputSystem::Instance().GetMouseScrollY();
    if (SCROLL_Y != 0.0F) {
      // m_camera.ProcessMouseScroll(SCROLL_Y);
      // engine::InputSystem::Instance().ResetMouseScroll();
    }
  }
}

void Scene::Render() {
  const int FB_W = static_cast<int>(m_vpW * m_vpScaleX);
  const int FB_H = static_cast<int>(m_vpH * m_vpScaleY);
  glViewport(0, 0, FB_W, FB_H);

  const float ASPECT = FB_H > 0 ? static_cast<float>(FB_W) / static_cast<float>(FB_H) : 1.0F;
  auto projection = glm::perspective(m_camera.GetZoom(), ASPECT, 0.1F, 2000.0F);

  auto view = m_camera.GetViewMatrix();
  m_renderer.BeginScene(view, projection);

  auto agents = LoadAgentsFromGPU();

  // Рендеринг объектов
  for (const auto& obj : m_sceneObjects.All()) {
    if (!obj.m_is_visible) {
      continue;
    }

    if (obj.m_agent_id < agents.size()) {
      const Agent& agent = agents[obj.m_agent_id];
      RenderAgent(agent, obj);
    }
  }

  m_renderer.UploadAgentsData(agents);
  m_renderer.DrawTerrain(m_terrain->GetVAO(), m_camera.GetPosition());
  m_renderer.RenderWithGeometryShader(m_windConfig.getCurrentWind(m_windTime));

  m_renderer.EndScene();
}

void Scene::Generate() {
  for (int i = 0; i < 50; i += 3) {
    for (int j = 0; j < 50; j += 3) {
      AddTree(500 + i, 500 + j, "default_tree");
    }
  }
}

std::vector<Agent> Scene::LoadAgentsFromGPU() {
  size_t currentCount = m_agentManager.getAgentCount();
  std::vector<Agent> agents(currentCount);

  cudaMemcpy(agents.data(), m_agentManager.getDeviceAgents(), currentCount * sizeof(Agent),
             cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost);

  cudaError_t err = cudaGetLastError();
  if (err != cudaSuccess) {
    std::println("CUDA memcpy error: {}", cudaGetErrorString(err));
  }

  return agents;
}
void Scene::LoadObjectModels(const std::string& object_name, const std::string& normal_path,
                             const std::string& burning_path, const std::string& burned_path) {
  try {
    ObjectModels models;
    models.m_normal = std::make_shared<Model>(normal_path);
    models.m_burning = std::make_shared<Model>(burning_path);
    models.m_burned = std::make_shared<Model>(burned_path);
    m_objectModels.Put(object_name, std::move(models));
  } catch (const std::exception& e) {
    std::cout << "Failed to load model '" << object_name << "': " << e.what() << '\n';
  }
}

void Scene::RenderAgent(const Agent& agent, const SceneObject& scene_obj) {
  glm::vec3 position(agent.position.x, agent.position.y, agent.position.z);

  // Получаем префаб
  const auto& prefab = m_prefabSystem.GetPrefab(scene_obj.m_object_type);

  // Получаем модель
  const ObjectModels* om = m_objectModels.Find(scene_obj.m_object_type);
  if ((om == nullptr) || !om->m_normal) {
    std::cerr << "[RenderAgent] no model for '" << scene_obj.m_object_type << "'\n";
    return;
  }

  // Определяем состояние агента
  AgentType state = AgentType::NORMAL;
  if (agent.type == AgentType::BURNED) {
    state = AgentType::BURNED;
  } else if (agent.isBurning() || agent.type == AgentType::BURNING) {
    state = AgentType::BURNING;
  }

  auto material = prefab.GetMaterialForState(state);
  auto model = om->m_normal;

  if (model && material) {
    m_renderer.DrawModelWithMaterial(*model, position, scene_obj.m_scale, m_camera.GetPosition(),
                                     material);
  } else {
    // Fallback
    m_renderer.DrawModel(*model, position, scene_obj.m_scale, m_camera.GetPosition());
  }
}

glm::mat4 Scene::GetProjMatrix(int w, int h) {
  return glm::perspective(m_camera.GetZoom(), static_cast<float>(w) / static_cast<float>(h), 0.1F,
                          2000.0F);
}

void Scene::Clear() {
  m_sceneObjects.Clear();
  m_agentManager.Clear();
}

void Scene::AddPrefab(const std::string& prefab_id, float x, float z) {
  const auto& prefab = m_prefabSystem.GetPrefab(prefab_id);

  // 1) гарантируем, что модели для этого prefab загружены
  EnsureModelsForPrefab(prefab_id, prefab);

  const float y = GetGroundHeight(x, z);

  // 2) создаём агента
  Agent agent = m_prefabSystem.CreateAgentFromPrefab(prefab, {x, y, z});
  m_agentManager.AddAgent(agent);

  // 3) объект сцены
  SceneObject obj;
  obj.m_agent_id = m_agentManager.getAgentCount() - 1;
  obj.m_object_type = prefab_id;  // ключ в m_objectModels
  obj.m_position = glm::vec3(x, y, z);
  obj.m_scale = prefab.m_modelScale;
  obj.m_is_visible = true;
  m_sceneObjects.Add(std::move(obj));
}

// Если нужно, оставь AddTree как шорткат:
void Scene::AddTree(float x, float z, const std::string& tree_type) {
  AddPrefab(tree_type, x, z);
}

// Список id префабов (проксируем)
const std::vector<std::string>& Scene::ListPrefabIds() const {
  return m_prefabSystem.ListIds();
}

void Scene::ReloadModelForPrefab(const std::string& prefab_id,
                                 const engine::data::AgentPrefab& prefab) {
  // Перезагрузка модели
  ObjectModels models;
  models.m_normal = std::make_shared<Model>(prefab.m_modelPath);
  models.m_burning = std::make_shared<Model>(prefab.m_modelPath);
  models.m_burned = std::make_shared<Model>(prefab.m_modelPath);
  m_objectModels.Put(prefab_id, std::move(models));

  // Обновляем префаб в системе (чтобы GetMaterialForState возвращал свежий
  // материал)
  auto& system_prefab = m_prefabSystem.GetPrefabMutable(prefab_id);
  system_prefab.normalMaterial = prefab.normalMaterial;
  system_prefab.burningMaterial = prefab.burningMaterial;
  system_prefab.burnedMaterial = prefab.burnedMaterial;

  // Обновляем scale для объектов сцены
  for (auto& obj : m_sceneObjects.All()) {
    if (obj.m_object_type == prefab_id) {
      obj.m_scale = prefab.m_modelScale;
    }
  }


  std::cout << "[Scene] Reloaded model for prefab '" << prefab_id << "'\n";
}

// привязываем модель к префабу (если нужно или не нужно)
void Scene::AddSceneObjectFromSerialized(const SceneObject& obj) {
  const auto& prefab = m_prefabSystem.GetPrefab(obj.m_object_type);
  EnsureModelsForPrefab(obj.m_object_type, prefab);
  SceneObject o = obj;
  o.m_scale = prefab.m_modelScale;
  m_sceneObjects.Add(std::move(o));
}

float Scene::GetGroundHeight(float x, float z) const {
  return m_terrain ? m_terrain->GetHeightAt(x, z) : 0.0F;
}

void Scene::AddFire(float x, float z, float intensity) {
  // теперь учитываем высоту земли и перенаправляем в 3D-вариант
  const float y = GetGroundHeight(x, z);
  AddFireAt(glm::vec3{x, y, z}, intensity);
}

void Scene::AddFireAt(const glm::vec3& world, float intensity) {
  // единая точка входа
  m_agentManager.AddFireAt(Float3{world.x, world.y, world.z}, intensity);
}

int Scene::FindClosestObjectXZ(const glm::vec3& world, float maxXZDist) const {
  return m_sceneObjects.FindClosestXZ(world, maxXZDist);
}

void Scene::RemoveSceneObjectByIndex(size_t idx) {
  const SceneObject* victim = m_sceneObjects.Get(idx);
  if (!victim) return;

  const int removed_agent = victim->m_agent_id;

  int swapped_from = -1;
  int swapped_to = -1;
  m_agentManager.RemoveAgentAt(removed_agent, &swapped_from, &swapped_to);

  m_sceneObjects.RemoveByIndex(idx);

  if (swapped_from >= 0 && swapped_to >= 0 && swapped_from != swapped_to) {
    for (auto& so : m_sceneObjects.All()) {
      if (so.m_agent_id == swapped_from) {
        so.m_agent_id = swapped_to;
        break;
      }
    }
  }
}


bool Scene::RemoveNearestAt(const glm::vec3& world, float maxXZDist) {
  const int idx = FindClosestObjectXZ(world, maxXZDist);
  if (idx < 0) {
    return false;
  }
  RemoveSceneObjectByIndex(static_cast<size_t>(idx));
  return true;
}

}  // namespace engine

===== FILE: ./src/core/scene/sceneObj/SceneObjectStore.cc =====
// scene/SceneObjectStore.cc
#include "SceneObjectStore.h"
#include <utility> // std::swap

namespace engine {

size_t SceneObjectStore::Add(SceneObject obj) {
  m_objs.push_back(std::move(obj));
  return m_objs.size() - 1;
}

void SceneObjectStore::RemoveByIndex(size_t idx) {
  if (idx >= m_objs.size()) { return;
}
  if (idx != m_objs.size() - 1) {
    std::swap(m_objs[idx], m_objs.back());
  }
  m_objs.pop_back();
}

SceneObject* SceneObjectStore::Get(size_t idx) {
  if (idx >= m_objs.size()) { return nullptr;
}
  return &m_objs[idx];
}

const SceneObject* SceneObjectStore::Get(size_t idx) const {
  if (idx >= m_objs.size()) { return nullptr;
}
  return &m_objs[idx];
}

int SceneObjectStore::FindClosestXZ(glm::vec3 world, float maxXZDist) const {
  int   best   = -1;
  float bestD2 = maxXZDist * maxXZDist;

  for (int i = 0; i < static_cast<int>(m_objs.size()); ++i) {
    const auto& o = m_objs[i];
    if (!o.m_is_visible) { continue;
}
    const float DX = o.m_position.x - world.x;
    const float DZ = o.m_position.z - world.z;
    const float D2 = (DX*DX) + (DZ*DZ);
    if (D2 <= bestD2) { bestD2 = D2; best = i; }
  }
  return best;
}

} // namespace engine

===== FILE: ./src/core/scene/Terrain.cc =====
#include "Terrain.h"
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
#include <memory>
#include <vector>

#include "graphics/IndexBuffer.h"
#include "graphics/VertexArrayObject.h"
#include "graphics/VertexBuffer.h"
#include <glm/gtc/noise.hpp>
#include <random>
namespace engine {
class Terrain::PImpl {
public:
  int m_width;
  int m_depth;
  float m_scale = 1.0f;
  std::vector<std::vector<float>> m_heightMap;
  std::shared_ptr<VertexArrayObject> m_vao;

  float FBM(glm::vec2 p, const TerrainGenerationSettings &s) const {
    std::mt19937 gen(s.seed);
    std::uniform_real_distribution<float> dist(0.0f, 1000.0f);
    glm::vec2 offset(dist(gen), dist(gen));

    float total = 0.0f;
    float amplitude = 1.0f;
    float freq = s.frequency;
    float maxValue = 0.0f;

    for (int i = 0; i < s.octaves; ++i) {
      glm::vec2 coord = (p + offset) * freq;
      total += glm::perlin(coord) * amplitude;
      maxValue += amplitude;
      amplitude *= s.persistence;
      freq *= s.lacunarity;
    }

    return total / maxValue;
  }

  void GenerateHeightmapRandom(const TerrainGenerationSettings &s) {
    m_width = s.width;
    m_depth = s.depth;
    m_scale = s.scale;
    m_heightMap.assign(m_width, std::vector<float>(m_depth, 0.0f));

    for (int z = 0; z < m_depth; ++z) {
      for (int x = 0; x < m_width; ++x) {
        float nx = static_cast<float>(x);
        float nz = static_cast<float>(z);

        float h = FBM({nx, nz}, s);

        h = (h + 1.0f) * 0.5f;

        m_heightMap[x][z] = h * s.maxHeight;
      }
    }
  }
  // В PImpl::GenerateMesh()
  void GenerateMesh() {
    std::vector<float> vertices;
    std::vector<uint32_t> indices;

    for (int z = 0; z < m_depth; ++z) {
      for (int x = 0; x < m_width; ++x) {
        float worldX = x * m_scale;
        float worldZ = z * m_scale;
        float y = m_heightMap[x][z];

        glm::vec3 normal = {0, 1, 0};
        if (x > 0 && x < m_width - 1 && z > 0 && z < m_depth - 1) {
          float hL = m_heightMap[x - 1][z];
          float hR = m_heightMap[x + 1][z];
          float hD = m_heightMap[x][z - 1];
          float hU = m_heightMap[x][z + 1];
          normal = glm::normalize(glm::vec3(hL - hR, 2.0f * m_scale, hD - hU));
        }

        // UV
        float u = static_cast<float>(x) / (m_width - 1);
        float v = static_cast<float>(z) / (m_depth - 1);

        vertices.insert(vertices.end(), {worldX, y, worldZ, normal.x, normal.y,
                                         normal.z, u, v});
      }
    }

    for (int z = 0; z < m_depth - 1; ++z) {
      for (int x = 0; x < m_width - 1; ++x) {
        uint32_t i = x + z * m_width;
        indices.insert(indices.end(), {i, i + m_width, i + 1, i + 1,
                                       i + m_width, i + m_width + 1});
      }
    }

    auto vbo =
        VertexBuffer::Create(vertices.data(), vertices.size() * sizeof(float));
    vbo->SetLayout({{ShaderDataType::Float3, "a_Position"},
                    {ShaderDataType::Float3, "a_Normal"},
                    {ShaderDataType::Float2, "a_TexCoord"}});

    auto ibo = IndexBuffer::Create(indices.data(), indices.size());
    m_vao = VertexArrayObject::Create();
    m_vao->AddVertexBuffer(vbo);
    m_vao->SetIndexBuffer(ibo);
  }
};

Terrain::Terrain() : m_impl(std::make_unique<PImpl>()) {}
Terrain::~Terrain() = default;

void Terrain::GenerateRandom(const TerrainGenerationSettings &s) {
  m_impl->GenerateHeightmapRandom(s);
  m_impl->GenerateMesh();
}

int Terrain::GetWidth() const { return m_impl->m_width; }
int Terrain::GetDepth() const { return m_impl->m_depth; }
float Terrain::GetHeightAt(float worldX, float worldZ) const {
  int x = static_cast<int>(worldX / m_impl->m_scale);
  int z = static_cast<int>(worldZ / m_impl->m_scale);

  if (x < 0 || x >= m_impl->m_width || z < 0 || z >= m_impl->m_depth)
    return 0.0f;

  return m_impl->m_heightMap[x][z];
}

std::shared_ptr<VertexArrayObject> Terrain::GetVAO() const {
  return m_impl->m_vao;
}

} // namespace engine

===== FILE: ./src/core/scene/Terrain.h =====
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>
#include <glm/glm.hpp>
#include <memory>
#include <string>
namespace engine {
class VertexArrayObject;
struct TerrainGenerationSettings {
  int width = 256;
  int depth = 256;
  uint32_t seed = 12345;
  float maxHeight = 50.0f;

  float frequency = 0.02f;
  int octaves = 6;
  float persistence = 0.5f;
  float lacunarity = 2.0f;
  bool smooth = true;
  float scale = 1.0f;
};
class Terrain {
public:
  Terrain();
  ~Terrain();

  void GenerateRandom(const TerrainGenerationSettings &settings);
  bool LoadHeightmap(const std::string &path);

  float GetHeightAt(float worldX, float worldZ) const;
  glm::vec3 GetNormalAt(float worldX, float worldZ) const;

  std::shared_ptr<VertexArrayObject> GetVAO() const;
  int GetWidth() const;
  int GetDepth() const;
  float GetScale() const;

private:
  class PImpl;
  std::unique_ptr<PImpl> m_impl;
};
} // namespace engine

Window::Window(int width, int height, const std::string& title) {
  if (glfwInit() == 0) {
    throw std::runtime_error("Failed to start GLFW");
  }

  glfwWindowHint(GLFW_CONTEXT_VERSION_MAJOR, 3);
  glfwWindowHint(GLFW_CONTEXT_VERSION_MINOR, 3);
  glfwWindowHint(GLFW_OPENGL_PROFILE, GLFW_OPENGL_CORE_PROFILE);
  m_window = glfwCreateWindow(width, height, title.c_str(), nullptr, nullptr);
  if (m_window == nullptr) {
    glfwTerminate();
    throw std::runtime_error("Failed to initialize window");
  }
  glfwMakeContextCurrent(m_window);
  glfwSetCursorPosCallback(m_window, MousePositionCallback);
  glfwSetMouseButtonCallback(m_window, MouseButtonCallback);
  glfwSetWindowUserPointer(m_window, this);
  glfwSetScrollCallback(m_window, MouseScrollCallback);
}
Window::~Window() {
  if (m_window != nullptr) {
    glfwDestroyWindow(m_window);
  }
  glfwTerminate();
}
void Window::PollEvents() {
    InputSystem::Instance().Update();
  glfwPollEvents();

  for (const auto& [glfwKey, ourKey] : keyMap) {
    bool pressed = glfwGetKey(m_window, glfwKey) == GLFW_PRESS;

    InputSystem::Instance().SetKeyState(ourKey, pressed);
  }


}
bool Window::ShouldClose() const {
  return glfwWindowShouldClose(m_window) != 0;
}
void Window::SwapBuffers() {
  glfwSwapBuffers(m_window);
}
GLFWwindow* Window::GetWindow() const {
  return m_window;
}

// clang-format off
// NOLINTBEGIN(llvm-include-order)
#ifndef GLFW_INCLUDE_NONE
#define GLFW_INCLUDE_NONE
#endif
#include <glad/glad.h>
#include <GLFW/glfw3.h>
// NOLINTEND(llvm-include-order)
// clang-format on

#include "Input.h"
#include <string>

namespace engine {
class Window {
  static void MousePositionCallback(GLFWwindow* window, double xpos, double ypos) {
    auto* win = static_cast<Window*>(glfwGetWindowUserPointer(window));
    if (win != nullptr) {
      InputSystem::Instance().SetMousePosition(xpos, ypos);
    }
  }

static void MouseButtonCallback(GLFWwindow* window, int button, int action, int /*mods*/) {
  auto* win = static_cast<Window*>(glfwGetWindowUserPointer(window));
  if (!win) return;

  engine::MouseButton mb;
  switch (button) {
    case GLFW_MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT:   mb = engine::MouseButton::Left;   break;
    case GLFW_MOUSE_BUTTON_RIGHT:  mb = engine::MouseButton::Right;  break;
    default:                       mb = engine::MouseButton::Middle; break;
  }
  engine::InputSystem::Instance().SetMouseButtonState(mb, action == GLFW_PRESS);
}
  static void MouseScrollCallback(GLFWwindow* window, double xoffset, double yoffset) {
    auto* win = static_cast<Window*>(glfwGetWindowUserPointer(window));
    if (win != nullptr) {
      InputSystem::Instance().SetMouseScrollY(yoffset);
    }
  }

 public:

#include "ModelData.h"
#include <iostream>

namespace engine::data {
    ModelData AssimpLoader::LoadModel(const std::string& path) {
        Assimp::Importer importer;
        const aiScene* scene = importer.ReadFile(path, ModelData::IMPORT_FLAGS);
        
        if (!scene || scene->mFlags & AI_SCENE_FLAGS_INCOMPLETE || !scene->mRootNode) {
            throw std::runtime_error("Assimp error: " + std::string(importer.GetErrorString()));
        }
        
        ModelData modelData;
        modelData.directory = path.substr(0, path.find_last_of('/'));
        
        for (unsigned int i = 0; i < scene->mNumMaterials; i++) {
            modelData.materials.push_back(
                ProcessMaterial(scene->mMaterials[i], modelData.directory)
            );
        }
        
        ProcessNode(scene->mRootNode, scene, modelData);
        
        return modelData;
    }

    void AssimpLoader::ProcessNode(aiNode *node, const aiScene *scene, ModelData &modelData)
    {
        for(unsigned int i = 0; i < node->mNumMeshes; i++)
        {
            aiMesh* mesh = scene->mMeshes[node->mMeshes[i]];
            modelData.meshes.push_back(ProcessMesh(mesh, scene));
        }
        for(unsigned int i = 0; i < node->mNumChildren; i++)
        {
            ProcessNode(node->mChildren[i], scene, modelData);
        }
    }

    MeshData AssimpLoader::ProcessMesh(aiMesh *mesh, const aiScene *scene)
    {
        MeshData meshData;
        meshData.materialIndex = mesh->mMaterialIndex;
        
        for(unsigned int i = 0; i < mesh->mNumVertices; i++) {
            Vertex vertex;

            // Позиции
            vertex.position = glm::vec3(
                mesh->mVertices[i].x,
                mesh->mVertices[i].y, 
                mesh->mVertices[i].z
            );

            // Нормали
            if(mesh->HasNormals()) {
                vertex.normal = glm::vec3(
                    mesh->mNormals[i].x,
                    mesh->mNormals[i].y,
                    mesh->mNormals[i].z
                );
            }

            // Текстурные координаты (берем первый набор)
            if(mesh->mTextureCoords[0]) {
                vertex.texCoords = glm::vec2(
                    mesh->mTextureCoords[0][i].x,
                    mesh->mTextureCoords[0][i].y
                );
            } else {
                vertex.texCoords = glm::vec2(0.0f);
            }

            // Тангенты и битангенты (если есть)
            if(mesh->HasTangentsAndBitangents()) {
                vertex.tangent = glm::vec3(
                    mesh->mTangents[i].x,
                    mesh->mTangents[i].y,
                    mesh->mTangents[i].z
                );
                vertex.bitangent = glm::vec3(
                    mesh->mBitangents[i].x,
                    mesh->mBitangents[i].y, 
                    mesh->mBitangents[i].z
                );
            }

            meshData.vertices.push_back(vertex);
        }

        // Обрабатываем индексы
        for(unsigned int i = 0; i < mesh->mNumFaces; i++) {
            aiFace face = mesh->mFaces[i];
            for(unsigned int j = 0; j < face.mNumIndices; j++) {
                meshData.indices.push_back(face.mIndices[j]);
            }
        }

        return meshData;
    }
    MaterialData AssimpLoader::ProcessMaterial(aiMaterial* material, const std::string& directory) {
        MaterialData materialData;

        aiString name;
        if (material->Get(AI_MATKEY_NAME, name) == AI_SUCCESS) {
            materialData.name = name.C_Str();
        }

        // Диффузный цвет
        aiColor3D diffuse(0.f, 0.f, 0.f);
        if (material->Get(AI_MATKEY_COLOR_DIFFUSE, diffuse) == AI_SUCCESS) {
            materialData.diffuseColor = glm::vec3(diffuse.r, diffuse.g, diffuse.b);
        }

        // Спекулярный цвет
        aiColor3D specular(0.f, 0.f, 0.f);
        if (material->Get(AI_MATKEY_COLOR_SPECULAR, specular) == AI_SUCCESS) {
            materialData.specularColor = glm::vec3(specular.r, specular.g, specular.b);
        }

        // Блеск
        float shininess = 32.0f;
        if (material->Get(AI_MATKEY_SHININESS, shininess) == AI_SUCCESS) {
            materialData.shininess = shininess;
        }

        auto diffuseMaps = LoadMaterialTextures(material, aiTextureType_DIFFUSE, "texture_diffuse", directory);
        materialData.textures.insert(materialData.textures.end(), diffuseMaps.begin(), diffuseMaps.end());

        auto specularMaps = LoadMaterialTextures(material, aiTextureType_SPECULAR, "texture_specular", directory);
        materialData.textures.insert(materialData.textures.end(), specularMaps.begin(), specularMaps.end());

        auto normalMaps = LoadMaterialTextures(material, aiTextureType_NORMALS, "texture_normal", directory);
        materialData.textures.insert(materialData.textures.end(), normalMaps.begin(), normalMaps.end());
       
        return materialData;
    }

    std::vector<TextureData> AssimpLoader::LoadMaterialTextures(
        aiMaterial* mat, aiTextureType type, const std::string& typeName, const std::string& directory) {
        
        std::vector<TextureData> textures;
        
        for (unsigned int i = 0; i < mat->GetTextureCount(type); i++) {
            aiString str;
            mat->GetTexture(type, i, &str);

            TextureData textureData;
            textureData.type = typeName;
            textureData.path = directory + "/" + str.C_Str();

            textures.push_back(textureData);
        }

        return textures;
    }
}
