===== FILE: ./src/data/PrefabSystem.cc =====
#include "PrefabSystem.h"
#include <algorithm>
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <iostream>
#include <stdexcept>
namespace fs = std::filesystem;
namespace engine::data {

static void PushUnique(std::vector<std::string>& v, const std::string& id) {
  if (std::ranges::find(v, id) == v.end()) {
    v.push_back(id);
  }
}

void PrefabSystem::SavePrefab(const std::string& name, const AgentPrefab& prefab) {
  m_prefabs[name] = prefab;
  PushUnique(m_idsInLoadOrder, name);
}

void PrefabSystem::SavePrefabToFile(const std::string& prefab_name, const std::string& file_path) {
  if (!PrefabExists(prefab_name)) {
    throw std::runtime_error("Prefab not found: " + prefab_name);
  }

  const AgentPrefab& prefab = GetPrefab(prefab_name);

  YAML::Node root;
  root["name"] = prefab_name;
  SerializePrefab(prefab, root);

  fs::path path(file_path);
  fs::create_directories(path.parent_path());

  std::ofstream file(file_path);
  file << root;
  PushUnique(m_idsInLoadOrder, prefab_name);
  std::cout << "Saved prefab '" << prefab_name << "' to " << file_path << '\n';
}
void PrefabSystem::LoadPrefabFromFile(const std::string& file_path) {
  if (!fs::exists(file_path)) {
    throw std::runtime_error("File not found: " + file_path);
  }

  YAML::Node root = YAML::LoadFile(file_path);

  // name из YAML, иначе — из имени файла
  std::string name;
  if (auto n = root["name"]; n && n.IsScalar()) {
    name = n.as<std::string>();
  } else {
    name = fs::path(file_path).stem().string();
  }

  AgentPrefab prefab = DeserializePrefab(root);
  prefab.m_name = name;  // <<< ВАЖНО: заполняем поле структуры

  // защита от дубликатов (как минимум лог и замена/пропуск)
  auto it = m_prefabs.find(name);
  if (it != m_prefabs.end()) {
    std::cerr << "[PrefabSystem] duplicate name '" << name << "' from " << file_path
              << " — replacing previous.\n";
  }

  m_prefabs[name] = std::move(prefab);
  PushUnique(m_idsInLoadOrder, name);
  std::cout << "Loaded prefab '" << name << "' from " << file_path << '\n';
}

const AgentPrefab& PrefabSystem::GetPrefab(const std::string& name) const {
  auto it = m_prefabs.find(name);
  if (it == m_prefabs.end()) {
    throw std::runtime_error("Prefab not found: " + name);
  }
  return it->second;
}
bool PrefabSystem::PrefabExists(const std::string& name) const {
  return m_prefabs.contains(name);
}

Agent PrefabSystem::CreateAgentFromPrefab(const std::string& prefab_name,
                                          const glm::vec3& position) {
  // было: const AgentPrefab& prefab = m_prefabs[prefab_name]; // может создать пустую запись!
  const AgentPrefab& prefab = GetPrefab(prefab_name);  // бросит исключение, если нет
  return CreateAgentFromPrefab(prefab, position);
}

Agent PrefabSystem::CreateAgentFromPrefab(const AgentPrefab& prefab, const glm::vec3& position) {
  Agent agent;
  agent.position = Float3::fromGlm(position);
  agent.fire_collider.bounds_min = Float3::fromGlm(prefab.m_bounds_min + position);
  agent.fire_collider.bounds_max = Float3::fromGlm(prefab.m_bounds_max + position);

  agent.fire_collider.point_count = std::min(static_cast<int>(prefab.m_firePoints.size()), 64);

  for (int i = 0; i < agent.fire_collider.point_count; ++i) {
    Float3 local_pos = Float3::fromGlm(prefab.m_firePoints[i].m_position);
    agent.fire_collider.heat_points[i] =
        Float3(position.x + local_pos.x, position.y + local_pos.y, position.z + local_pos.z);
    agent.fire_collider.fuels[i] = prefab.m_firePoints[i].m_initialFuel;
    agent.fire_collider.intensities[i] = 0.0F;
  }

  agent.intensity = prefab.m_physics.m_intencity;
  agent.type = prefab.m_type;

  return agent;
}

void PrefabSystem::CreatePrefabFromAgent(const std::string& name, const Agent& agent,
                                         const std::string& model_path, const glm::vec3& scale) {
  AgentPrefab prefab;
  prefab.m_name = name;
  prefab.m_type = agent.type;
  prefab.m_modelPath = model_path;
  prefab.m_modelScale = scale;
  prefab.m_bounds_min = agent.fire_collider.bounds_min.toGlm();
  prefab.m_bounds_max = agent.fire_collider.bounds_max.toGlm();

  for (int i = 0; i < agent.fire_collider.point_count; i++) {
    AgentPrefab::FirePoint fp;
    fp.m_position = glm::vec3(agent.fire_collider.heat_points[i].x - agent.position.x,
                              agent.fire_collider.heat_points[i].y - agent.position.y,
                              agent.fire_collider.heat_points[i].z - agent.position.z);
    fp.m_initialFuel = agent.fire_collider.fuels[i];
    prefab.m_firePoints.push_back(fp);
  }

  prefab.m_physics.m_intencity = agent.intensity;

  m_prefabs[name] = prefab;
  PushUnique(m_idsInLoadOrder, name);
}

std::vector<std::string> PrefabSystem::GetPrefabNames() const {
  std::vector<std::string> result;
  result.reserve(m_prefabs.size());
  std::ranges::transform(m_prefabs, std::back_inserter(result),
                         [](const auto& pair) { return pair.first; });
  return result;
}
std::vector<std::string> PrefabSystem::GetPrefabsByType(AgentType type) const {
  std::vector<std::string> prefabs;

  for (auto [name, prefab] : m_prefabs) {
    if (prefab.m_type == type) {
      prefabs.push_back(name);
    }
  }

  return prefabs;
}
void PrefabSystem::SerializePrefab(const AgentPrefab& prefab, YAML::Node& node) const {
  node["type"] = static_cast<int>(prefab.m_type);
  node["model_path"] = prefab.m_modelPath;
  node["model_scale"] =
      std::vector<float>{prefab.m_modelScale.x, prefab.m_modelScale.y, prefab.m_modelScale.z};
  node["bounds_min"] =
      std::vector<float>{prefab.m_bounds_min.x, prefab.m_bounds_min.y, prefab.m_bounds_min.z};
  node["bounds_max"] =
      std::vector<float>{prefab.m_bounds_max.x, prefab.m_bounds_max.y, prefab.m_bounds_max.z};

  node["physics"]["intensity"] = prefab.m_physics.m_intencity;

  for (const auto& fp : prefab.m_firePoints) {
    YAML::Node fp_node;
    fp_node["position"] = std::vector<float>{fp.m_position.x, fp.m_position.y, fp.m_position.z};
    fp_node["initial_fuel"] = fp.m_initialFuel;
    node["fire_points"].push_back(fp_node);
  }
  YAML::Node normal_node;
  YAML::Node burning_node;
  YAML::Node burned_node;
  
  SerializeMaterialInfo(prefab.normal_material, normal_node);
  SerializeMaterialInfo(prefab.burning_material, burning_node);
  SerializeMaterialInfo(prefab.burned_material, burned_node);
  
  // ПРИСВАИВАЕМ созданные ноды
  node["materials"]["normal"] = normal_node;
  node["materials"]["burning"] = burning_node;
  node["materials"]["burned"] = burned_node;
}

// устойчивый к неполным файлам
AgentPrefab PrefabSystem::DeserializePrefab(const YAML::Node& node) const {
  AgentPrefab prefab;

  // type
  if (auto t = node["type"]) {
    prefab.m_type = static_cast<AgentType>(t.as<int>());
  } else {
    prefab.m_type = AgentType::NORMAL;
  }

  // model_path
  if (auto mp = node["model_path"]) {
    prefab.m_modelPath = mp.as<std::string>();
  } else {
    prefab.m_modelPath.clear();
  }

  // model_scale (опционален)
  if (auto ms = node["model_scale"]) {
    auto v = ms.as<std::vector<float>>();
    if (v.size() >= 3)
      prefab.m_modelScale = glm::vec3(v[0], v[1], v[2]);
    else
      prefab.m_modelScale = glm::vec3(1.0f);
  } else {
    prefab.m_modelScale = glm::vec3(1.0f);
  }

  // bounds_min / bounds_max (обязательные для твоей логики — но читаем бережно)
  if (auto bmin = node["bounds_min"]) {
    auto v = bmin.as<std::vector<float>>();
    if (v.size() >= 3)
      prefab.m_bounds_min = glm::vec3(v[0], v[1], v[2]);
  }
  if (auto bmax = node["bounds_max"]) {
    auto v = bmax.as<std::vector<float>>();
    if (v.size() >= 3)
      prefab.m_bounds_max = glm::vec3(v[0], v[1], v[2]);
  }

  // physics.intensity (может отсутствовать)
  if (auto phys = node["physics"]) {
    if (auto inten = phys["intensity"]) {
      prefab.m_physics.m_intencity = inten.as<float>();
    } else {
      prefab.m_physics.m_intencity = 0.0f;
    }
  } else {
    prefab.m_physics.m_intencity = 0.0f;
  }

  // fire_points (опциональны)
  prefab.m_firePoints.clear();
  if (auto fps = node["fire_points"]) {
    for (const auto& fp_node : fps) {
      AgentPrefab::FirePoint fp{};
      if (auto pos = fp_node["position"]) {
        auto v = pos.as<std::vector<float>>();
        if (v.size() >= 3)
          fp.m_position = glm::vec3(v[0], v[1], v[2]);
      }
      if (auto fuel = fp_node["initial_fuel"]) {
        fp.m_initialFuel = fuel.as<float>();
      } else {
        fp.m_initialFuel = 100.0f;
      }
      prefab.m_firePoints.push_back(fp);
    }
  }
    // Materials - ЗАПОЛНЯЕМ MaterialInfo
    if (node["materials"]["normal"]) {
        prefab.normal_material = ParseMaterialInfo(node["materials"]["normal"]);
    }
    if (node["materials"]["burning"]) {
        prefab.burning_material = ParseMaterialInfo(node["materials"]["burning"]);
    }
    if (node["materials"]["burned"]) {
        prefab.burned_material = ParseMaterialInfo(node["materials"]["burned"]);
    }
   
    prefab.LoadMaterials();

  return prefab;
}

void PrefabSystem::Clear() {
  m_prefabs.clear();
  m_idsInLoadOrder.clear();
}

void PrefabSystem::LoadAllFromDirectory(const std::string& dir) {
  namespace fs = std::filesystem;
  Clear();

  fs::path root(dir);
  if (!fs::exists(root))
    return;

  for (auto& e : fs::directory_iterator(root)) {
    if (!e.is_regular_file())
      continue;
    const auto ext = e.path().extension().string();
    if (ext != ".yaml" && ext != ".yml")
      continue;

    try {
      LoadPrefabFromFile(e.path().string());
    } catch (const std::exception& ex) {
      std::cerr << "[PrefabSystem] skip " << e.path() << " : " << ex.what() << "\n";
      continue;
    }
  }
}

===== FILE: ./src/data/PrefabSystem.h =====
#pragma once
#include <yaml-cpp/yaml.h>
#include <glm/glm.hpp>
#include <string>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <vector>
#include "core/agent.h"
#include "graphics/Material.h"
namespace engine::data {

struct AgentPrefab {
  std::string m_name;
  AgentType m_type = AgentType::NORMAL;

  glm::vec3 m_modelScale = glm::vec3(1.0F);

  std::string m_modelPath;

  glm::vec3 m_bounds_min = {-1.0F, 0.0F, -1.0F};
  glm::vec3 m_bounds_max = {1.0F, 2.0F, 1.0F};

  struct FirePoint {
    glm::vec3 m_position;
    float m_initialFuel = 100.0F;
  };
  std::vector<FirePoint> m_firePoints;

  struct Phisics {
    float m_intencity;
  } m_physics;

  struct MaterialInfo {
    std::string diffuse_path;
    std::string specular_path;
    std::string normal_path;
    glm::vec3 diffuse_color = glm::vec3(1.0f, 0.0f, 1.0f);
    glm::vec3 specular_color = glm::vec3(0.5f);
    float shininess = 32.0f;

    // Создает материал из этих путей
    std::shared_ptr<Material> CreateMaterial() const {
      return Material::Create(diffuse_path, specular_path, normal_path, diffuse_color,
                              specular_color, shininess);
    }
  };

  MaterialInfo normal_material;
  MaterialInfo burning_material;
  MaterialInfo burned_material;

  std::shared_ptr<Material> normalMaterial;
  std::shared_ptr<Material> burningMaterial;
  std::shared_ptr<Material> burnedMaterial;

  void LoadMaterials() {
    normalMaterial = normal_material.CreateMaterial();
    burningMaterial = burning_material.CreateMaterial();
    burnedMaterial = burned_material.CreateMaterial();
  }
  std::shared_ptr<Material> GetMaterialForState(AgentType state) const {
    switch (state) {
      case AgentType::BURNED:
        return burnedMaterial;
      case AgentType::BURNING:
        return burningMaterial;
      default:
        return normalMaterial;
    }
  }
};


class PrefabSystem {
 public:
  void SavePrefab(const std::string& name, const AgentPrefab& prefab);
  void SavePrefabToFile(const std::string& prefab_name, const std::string& file_path);
  void LoadPrefabFromFile(const std::string& file_path);
  const AgentPrefab& GetPrefab(const std::string& name) const;
  bool PrefabExists(const std::string& name) const;

  Agent CreateAgentFromPrefab(const std::string& prefab_name, const glm::vec3& position);
  Agent CreateAgentFromPrefab(const AgentPrefab& prefab, const glm::vec3& position);
  void CreatePrefabFromAgent(const std::string& name, const Agent& agent,
                             const std::string& model_path,
                             const glm::vec3& scale = glm::vec3(1.0F));

  std::vector<std::string> GetPrefabNames() const;
  std::vector<std::string> GetPrefabsByType(AgentType type) const;
  const std::vector<std::string>& ListIds() const { return m_idsInLoadOrder; }

  void LoadAllFromDirectory(const std::string& dir);
  void Clear();
  
  AgentPrefab& GetPrefabMutable(const std::string& name) {
    auto it = m_prefabs.find(name);
    if (it == m_prefabs.end())
        throw std::runtime_error("Prefab not found: " + name);
    return it->second;
}

 private:
  AgentPrefab::MaterialInfo ParseMaterialInfo(const YAML::Node& node) const {
    AgentPrefab::MaterialInfo info;

    if (node["diffuse_path"]) {
      info.diffuse_path = node["diffuse_path"].as<std::string>();
    }
    if (node["specular_path"]) {
      info.specular_path = node["specular_path"].as<std::string>();
    }
    if (node["normal_path"]) {
      info.normal_path = node["normal_path"].as<std::string>();
    }
    if (node["diffuse_color"]) {
      info.diffuse_color = ParseVec3(node["diffuse_color"], glm::vec3(0.8f));
    }
    if (node["specular_color"]) {
      info.specular_color = ParseVec3(node["specular_color"], glm::vec3(0.5f));
    }
    if (node["shininess"]) {
      info.shininess = node["shininess"].as<float>(32.0f);
    }

    return info;
  }

void SerializeMaterialInfo(const AgentPrefab::MaterialInfo& info, YAML::Node& node) const {
    node["diffuse_path"]  = info.diffuse_path;
    node["specular_path"] = info.specular_path;
    node["normal_path"]   = info.normal_path;

    // inline массив для цвета
    YAML::Node diffuseNode(YAML::NodeType::Sequence);
    diffuseNode.push_back(info.diffuse_color.x);
    diffuseNode.push_back(info.diffuse_color.y);
    diffuseNode.push_back(info.diffuse_color.z);
    diffuseNode.SetStyle(YAML::EmitterStyle::Flow);
    node["diffuse_color"] = diffuseNode;

    YAML::Node specularNode(YAML::NodeType::Sequence);
    specularNode.push_back(info.specular_color.x);
    specularNode.push_back(info.specular_color.y);
    specularNode.push_back(info.specular_color.z);
    specularNode.SetStyle(YAML::EmitterStyle::Flow);
    node["specular_color"] = specularNode;

    node["shininess"] = info.shininess;
}


//   void SerializeMaterialInfo(const AgentPrefab::MaterialInfo& info, YAML::Node& node) const {
//     node["diffuse_path"] = info.diffuse_path;
//     node["specular_path"] = info.specular_path;
//     node["normal_path"] = info.normal_path;

//     node["diffuse_color"] = YAML::Node(YAML::NodeType::Sequence);
//     node["diffuse_color"].push_back(info.diffuse_color.x);
//     node["diffuse_color"].push_back(info.diffuse_color.y);
//     node["diffuse_color"].push_back(info.diffuse_color.z);

//     node["specular_color"] = YAML::Node(YAML::NodeType::Sequence);
//     node["specular_color"].push_back(info.specular_color.x);
//     node["specular_color"].push_back(info.specular_color.y);
//     node["specular_color"].push_back(info.specular_color.z);

//     node["shininess"] = info.shininess;
//   }
  static glm::vec3 ParseVec3(const YAML::Node& node,
                             const glm::vec3& default_value = glm::vec3(0.0f)) {
    if (!node || !node.IsSequence() || node.size() != 3) {
      return default_value;
    }

    try {
      return glm::vec3(node[0].as<float>(), node[1].as<float>(), node[2].as<float>());
    } catch (...) {
      return default_value;
    }
  }
  void SerializePrefab(const AgentPrefab& prefab, YAML::Node& node) const;

  AgentPrefab DeserializePrefab(const YAML::Node& node) const;
  std::unordered_map<std::string, AgentPrefab> m_prefabs;

  std::vector<std::string> m_idsInLoadOrder;
};
}  // namespace engine::data

===== FILE: ./src/data/SceneSerializer.cc =====
#include "SceneSerializer.h"
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include "core/scene/Scene.h"

#include <iostream>
#include <string>
namespace engine::data {
SceneSerializer::SceneSerializer(std::shared_ptr<Scene> scene) : m_scene(scene) {}

bool SceneSerializer::Serialize(const std::string& filepath) {
  try {
    YAML::Emitter out;
    out << YAML::BeginMap;

    // Метаданные
    out << YAML::Key << "metadata" << YAML::Value;
    out << YAML::BeginMap;
    out << YAML::Key << "version" << YAML::Value << "1.0";
    out << YAML::Key << "date" << YAML::Value << getCurrentDateTime();
    out << YAML::EndMap;

    // Агенты
    out << YAML::Key << "agents" << YAML::Value;
    out << YAML::BeginSeq;
    auto agents = m_scene->LoadAgentsFromGPU();
    for (int i = 0; i < agents.size(); i++) {
      SerializeAgent(out, agents[i], i);
    }
    out << YAML::EndSeq;

    // SceneObject'ы
    out << YAML::Key << "scene_objects" << YAML::Value;
    out << YAML::BeginSeq;
    for (int i = 0; i < m_scene->GetSceneObjects().size(); i++) {
      SerializeSceneObject(out, m_scene->GetSceneObjects()[i], i);
    }
    out << YAML::EndSeq;

    out << YAML::EndMap;

    std::ofstream file(filepath);
    file << out.c_str();
    std::cout << "Scene saved to: " << filepath << std::endl;
    return true;

  } catch (const std::exception& e) {
    std::cerr << "Failed to serialize scene: " << e.what() << std::endl;
    return false;
  }
}

YAML::Emitter& SceneSerializer::SerializeFireCollider(YAML::Emitter& out,
                                                      const FireCollider& collider) {
  {
    out << YAML::BeginMap;

    // Bounds
    out << YAML::Key << "bounds_min" << YAML::Value;
    out << YAML::Flow << YAML::BeginSeq << collider.bounds_min.x << collider.bounds_min.y
        << collider.bounds_min.z << YAML::EndSeq;

    out << YAML::Key << "bounds_max" << YAML::Value;
    out << YAML::Flow << YAML::BeginSeq << collider.bounds_max.x << collider.bounds_max.y
        << collider.bounds_max.z << YAML::EndSeq;

    out << YAML::Key << "point_count" << YAML::Value << collider.point_count;

    // Heat points (только используемые)
    out << YAML::Key << "heat_points" << YAML::Value;
    out << YAML::BeginSeq;
    for (int i = 0; i < collider.point_count; i++) {
      out << YAML::Flow << YAML::BeginSeq << collider.heat_points[i].x << collider.heat_points[i].y
          << collider.heat_points[i].z << YAML::EndSeq;
    }
    out << YAML::EndSeq;

    // Intensities
    out << YAML::Key << "intensities" << YAML::Value;
    out << YAML::Flow << YAML::BeginSeq;
    for (int i = 0; i < collider.point_count; i++) {
      out << collider.intensities[i];
    }
    out << YAML::EndSeq;

    // Fuels
    out << YAML::Key << "fuels" << YAML::Value;
    out << YAML::Flow << YAML::BeginSeq;
    for (int i = 0; i < collider.point_count; i++) {
      out << collider.fuels[i];
    }
    out << YAML::EndSeq;

    out << YAML::EndMap;
    return out;
  }
}

YAML::Emitter& SceneSerializer::SerializeAgent(YAML::Emitter& out, const Agent& agent, int id) {
  out << YAML::BeginMap;
  out << YAML::Key << "id" << YAML::Value << id;
  out << YAML::Key << "type" << YAML::Value << static_cast<int>(agent.type);
  out << YAML::Key << "object_id" << YAML::Value << agent.object_id;
  out << YAML::Key << "intensity" << YAML::Value << agent.intensity;

  out << YAML::Key << "position" << YAML::Value;
  out << YAML::Flow << YAML::BeginSeq << agent.position.x << agent.position.y << agent.position.z
      << YAML::EndSeq;

  // FireCollider
  out << YAML::Key << "fire_collider" << YAML::Value;
  SerializeFireCollider(out, agent.fire_collider);

  out << YAML::EndMap;
  return out;
}

YAML::Emitter& SceneSerializer::SerializeSceneObject(YAML::Emitter& out, const SceneObject& obj,
                                                     int id) {
  out << YAML::BeginMap;
  out << YAML::Key << "id" << YAML::Value << id;
  out << YAML::Key << "agent_id" << YAML::Value << obj.m_agent_id;
  out << YAML::Key << "object_type" << YAML::Value << obj.m_object_type;
  out << YAML::Key << "is_visible" << YAML::Value << obj.m_is_visible;

  // Позиция и масштаб
  out << YAML::Key << "position" << YAML::Value;
  out << YAML::Flow << YAML::BeginSeq << obj.m_position.x << obj.m_position.y << obj.m_position.z
      << YAML::EndSeq;

  out << YAML::Key << "scale" << YAML::Value;
  out << YAML::Flow << YAML::BeginSeq << obj.m_scale.x << obj.m_scale.y << obj.m_scale.z << YAML::EndSeq;

  out << YAML::EndMap;
  return out;
}

void SceneSerializer::Deserialize(const std::string& filename) {
  try {
    YAML::Node scene_data = YAML::LoadFile(filename);

    // Очищаем сцену
    m_scene->Clear();

    // 1. Загружаем агентов
    const YAML::Node& agents_node = scene_data["agents"];
    std::vector<Agent> agents;

    for (const YAML::Node& agent_node : agents_node) {
      agents.push_back(DeserializeAgent(agent_node));
    }

    // Загружаем агентов в GPU
    m_scene->GetAgentManager().SetAgents(agents);

    const YAML::Node& objects_node = scene_data["scene_objects"];
    for (const YAML::Node& obj_node : objects_node) {
      SceneObject obj = DeserializeSceneObject(obj_node);
      m_scene->AddSceneObjectFromSerialized(obj);
    }

    std::cout << "Scene loaded: " << agents.size() << " agents, " << objects_node.size()
              << " objects" << std::endl;

  } catch (const std::exception& e) {
    std::cerr << "Failed to deserialize scene: " << e.what() << std::endl;
  }
}
SceneObject SceneSerializer::DeserializeSceneObject(const YAML::Node& obj_node) {
  SceneObject obj;

  obj.m_agent_id = obj_node["agent_id"].as<int>();
  obj.m_object_type = obj_node["object_type"].as<std::string>();
  obj.m_is_visible = obj_node["is_visible"].as<bool>();

  // Позиция
  const YAML::Node& pos_node = obj_node["position"];
  obj.m_position =
      glm::vec3(pos_node[0].as<float>(), pos_node[1].as<float>(), pos_node[2].as<float>());

  // Масштаб
  const YAML::Node& scale_node = obj_node["scale"];
  obj.m_scale =
      glm::vec3(scale_node[0].as<float>(), scale_node[1].as<float>(), scale_node[2].as<float>());

  return obj;
}

FireCollider SceneSerializer::DeserializeFireCollider(const YAML::Node& collider_node) {
  FireCollider collider;

  const YAML::Node& min_node = collider_node["bounds_min"];
  collider.bounds_min =
      Float3(min_node[0].as<float>(), min_node[1].as<float>(), min_node[2].as<float>());

  const YAML::Node& max_node = collider_node["bounds_max"];
  collider.bounds_max =
      Float3(max_node[0].as<float>(), max_node[1].as<float>(), max_node[2].as<float>());

  // Point count
  collider.point_count = collider_node["point_count"].as<int>();

  // Heat points
  const YAML::Node& points_node = collider_node["heat_points"];
  for (int i = 0; i < collider.point_count && i < points_node.size(); i++) {
    const YAML::Node& point_node = points_node[i];
    collider.heat_points[i] =
        Float3(point_node[0].as<float>(), point_node[1].as<float>(), point_node[2].as<float>());
  }

  // Intensities
  const YAML::Node& intensities_node = collider_node["intensities"];
  for (int i = 0; i < collider.point_count && i < intensities_node.size(); i++) {
    collider.intensities[i] = intensities_node[i].as<float>();
  }

  // Fuels
  const YAML::Node& fuels_node = collider_node["fuels"];
  for (int i = 0; i < collider.point_count && i < fuels_node.size(); i++) {
    collider.fuels[i] = fuels_node[i].as<float>();
  }

  return collider;
}

Agent SceneSerializer::DeserializeAgent(const YAML::Node& agent_node) {
  Agent agent;

  agent.type = static_cast<AgentType>(agent_node["type"].as<int>());
  agent.object_id = agent_node["object_id"].as<int>();
  agent.intensity = agent_node["intensity"].as<float>();

  const YAML::Node& pos_node = agent_node["position"];
  agent.position =
      Float3(pos_node[0].as<float>(), pos_node[1].as<float>(), pos_node[2].as<float>());

  if (agent_node["fire_collider"]) {
    agent.fire_collider = DeserializeFireCollider(agent_node["fire_collider"]);
  }

  return agent;
}
}  // namespace engine::data

#pragma once
#include "core/scene/Scene.h"

#include <yaml-cpp/emitterdef.h>

namespace engine::data {
    class SceneSerializer {
        public:
          SceneSerializer(std::shared_ptr<Scene> scene);

          bool Serialize(const std::string& path);
          
          void Deserialize(const std::string& path);
        private:
          std::string getCurrentDateTime() {
            auto now = std::chrono::system_clock::now();
            auto in_time_t = std::chrono::system_clock::to_time_t(now);

            std::stringstream ss;
            ss << std::put_time(std::localtime(&in_time_t), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S");
            return ss.str();
          }
          YAML::Emitter& SerializeAgent(YAML::Emitter& out, const Agent& agent, int id);
          YAML::Emitter& SerializeSceneObject(YAML::Emitter& out, const SceneObject& obj, int id);

          YAML::Emitter& SerializeFireCollider(YAML::Emitter& out, const FireCollider& collider);
          SceneObject DeserializeSceneObject(const YAML::Node& obj_node);
          Agent DeserializeAgent(const YAML::Node& agent_node);
          FireCollider DeserializeFireCollider(const YAML::Node& collider_node);
          std::shared_ptr<Scene> m_scene;
    };
}

#include "Material.h"
#include "graphics/Texture.h"
#include <exception>
#include <iostream>

namespace engine {
std::shared_ptr<Material> Material::Create(const std::string& diffusePath,
        const std::string& specularPath, 
        const std::string& normalPath,
        const glm::vec3& diffuseColor,
        const glm::vec3& specularColor,
        float shininess) {
            auto  material = std::make_shared<Material>();
            if(!diffusePath.empty()) {
                try {
                    material->m_diffuseTexture = Texture::Create(diffusePath);
                } catch(const std::exception& e) {
                    std::cout << "Failed to load diffuse texture: " << e.what() << std::endl;
                }
            }

            if(!specularPath.empty()) {
                try {
                    material->m_specularTexture = Texture::Create(specularPath);
                } catch(const std::exception& e) {
                    std::cout << "Failed to load specular texture: " << e.what() << std::endl;
                }
            }

            if(!normalPath.empty()) {
                try {
                    material->m_normalTexture = Texture::Create(normalPath);
                } catch (const std::exception& e) {
                    std::cout << "Failed to load normal texture" << e.what() << std::endl;
                }
            }
            std::cout << "Diffuse color create: " << diffuseColor.r << ", " << diffuseColor.g << ", " << diffuseColor.b << std::endl;

            material->m_diffuseColor = diffuseColor;
            material->m_specularColor = specularColor;
            return material;
        }

void Material::Bind(Shader& shader) const {
    shader.SetVec3("material.diffuse", m_diffuseColor);
    shader.SetVec3("material.specular", m_specularColor);
    shader.SetBool("material.use_diffuse_map", false);
    shader.SetBool("material.use_normal_map", false);
    shader.SetBool("material.use_specular_map", false);

    shader.SetFloat("material.shininess", m_shininess);
}

} // namespace engine

===== FILE: ./src/graphics/Model.cc =====
#include "Model.h"
#include <iostream>
namespace engine {
    Mesh::Mesh(const data::MeshData& meshData, const data::MaterialData& material)
        : m_material(material) {
        SetupMesh(meshData);
        
        
    }
    
    void Mesh::Draw(Shader& shader) {
        // Биндим текстуры
        unsigned int diffuseNr = 1;
        unsigned int specularNr = 1;
        unsigned int normalNr = 1;
        
        for (unsigned int i = 0; i < m_material.textures.size(); i++) {
            const auto& texInfo = m_material.textures[i];
            texInfo.texture->Bind(i);
            
            std::string number;
            std::string name = "texture_";
            
            if (texInfo.type == "diffuse")
                number = std::to_string(diffuseNr++);
            else if (texInfo.type == "specular")
                number = std::to_string(specularNr++);
            else if (texInfo.type == "normal")
                number = std::to_string(normalNr++);
                
            shader.SetInt(("material." + name + number).c_str(), i);
        }
        
        glActiveTexture(GL_TEXTURE0);
        
        SetupMaterial(shader, m_material);
        m_vao->Bind();
        
        glDrawElements(GL_TRIANGLES, m_indexCount, GL_UNSIGNED_INT, 0);
        glBindVertexArray(0);
    }

    void Mesh::DrawInstanced(Shader& shader, const std::vector<glm::mat4>& instanceMatrices) {
        if (instanceMatrices.empty()) return;
    
        SetupMaterial(shader, m_material);
        m_vao->Bind();
        
        m_vao->AddVertexBuffer(m_instanceBuffer);
        
        m_instanceBuffer->SetData(instanceMatrices.data(), instanceMatrices.size() * sizeof(glm::mat4));
        glDrawElementsInstanced(GL_TRIANGLES, m_indexCount, GL_UNSIGNED_INT, 0, instanceMatrices.size());
        
        m_vao->Unbind();
    }

    void Mesh::DrawGeometryOnly(Shader& shader) {
        m_vao->Bind();
        glDrawElements(GL_TRIANGLES, m_indexCount, GL_UNSIGNED_INT, 0);
        m_vao->Unbind();
    }

    
    void Mesh::SetupMaterial(Shader& shader, const data::MaterialData& material) {
          glm::vec3 diffuse = (material.diffuseColor == glm::vec3(0.0f)) 
        ? glm::vec3(0.8f) : material.diffuseColor;
        shader.SetVec3("material.diffuse", material.diffuseColor);
        shader.SetVec3("material.specular", material.specularColor);
        shader.SetFloat("material.shininess", material.shininess);
    }
    
    void Mesh::SetupMesh(const data::MeshData& meshData) {
        m_vao = VertexArrayObject::Create();
        
        m_vbo = VertexBuffer::Create(
            meshData.vertices.size() * sizeof(data::Vertex)
        );
        m_vbo->SetData(meshData.vertices.data(), meshData.vertices.size() * sizeof(data::Vertex));

        m_vbo->SetLayout({
            {ShaderDataType::Float3, "a_position"},
            {ShaderDataType::Float3, "a_normal"}, 
            {ShaderDataType::Float2, "a_texCoords"},
            {ShaderDataType::Float3, "a_tangent"},
            {ShaderDataType::Float3, "a_bitangent"}
        });

        m_vao->AddVertexBuffer(m_vbo);
        
        m_ebo = IndexBuffer::Create(
            const_cast<uint32_t*>(meshData.indices.data()),
            meshData.indices.size()
        );

        m_vao->SetIndexBuffer(m_ebo);
        m_indexCount = meshData.indices.size();
    }
    void Model::Draw(Shader& shader)
    {
        for (auto& mesh : m_meshes) {
            mesh.Draw(shader);
        }
    }
    void Model::DrawInstanced(Shader& shader, const std::vector<glm::mat4>& instanceMatrices) {
        if (instanceMatrices.empty()) return;
        
        for (auto& mesh : m_meshes) {
            mesh.DrawInstanced(shader, instanceMatrices);
        }
    }

    void Model::DrawGeometryOnly(Shader& shader) {
          for (auto& mesh : m_meshes) {
            mesh.DrawGeometryOnly(shader);
        }
    }

    void Model::SetupModel()
    {
        for (size_t i = 0; i < m_modelData.meshes.size(); i++) {
            const auto& meshData = m_modelData.meshes[i];
            
            const data::MaterialData* material = nullptr;
            if (meshData.materialIndex < m_modelData.materials.size()) {
                material = &m_modelData.materials[meshData.materialIndex];
            } else {
                static data::MaterialData defaultMaterial;
                material = &defaultMaterial;
            }
            
            data::MaterialData materialWithTextures = *material;
            for (auto& texInfo : materialWithTextures.textures) {
                bool found = false;
                for (const auto& cachedTex : m_texturesLoaded) {
                    if (cachedTex.path == texInfo.path) {
                        texInfo.texture = cachedTex.texture;
                        found = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                
                if (!found) {
                    texInfo.texture = Texture::Create(texInfo.path);
                    m_texturesLoaded.push_back(texInfo);
                }
            }
            
            m_meshes.emplace_back(meshData, materialWithTextures);
        }
    }
}

===== FILE: ./src/graphics/OpenGL/OpenGLIndexBuffer.cc =====
#include "OpenGLIndexBuffer.h"

namespace engine {
std::unique_ptr<IndexBuffer> CreateOpenGLIndexBuffer(uint32_t *indices,
                                                     uint32_t count) {
  return std::make_unique<OpenGLIndexBuffer>(indices, count);
}

OpenGLIndexBuffer::OpenGLIndexBuffer(uint32_t *indices, uint32_t count) {
  m_count = count;
  glGenBuffers(1, &m_id);
  glBindBuffer(GL_ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER, m_id);
  glBufferData(GL_ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER, count * sizeof(uint32_t), indices,
               GL_STATIC_DRAW);
}

OpenGLIndexBuffer::~OpenGLIndexBuffer() { glDeleteBuffers(1, &m_id); }

void OpenGLIndexBuffer::Bind() const {
  glBindBuffer(GL_ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER, m_id);
}

void OpenGLIndexBuffer::Unbind() const {
  glBindBuffer(GL_ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER, 0);
}

} // namespace engine

===== FILE: ./src/graphics/OpenGL/OpenGLShader.cc =====
#include "OpenGLShader.h"
#include <fstream>
#include <iostream>
#include <memory>
#include <sstream>
namespace engine {
std::unique_ptr<Shader> CreateOpenGLShader(const std::string &filename) {
  return std::make_unique<OpenGLShader>(filename);
}
std::unique_ptr<Shader> CreateOpenGLShader(const std::string &vertexSrc,
                                           const std::string &fragmentSrc) {
  return std::make_unique<OpenGLShader>(vertexSrc, fragmentSrc);
}

std::unique_ptr<Shader> CreateOpenGLShader(const std::string &vertexSrc,
                                           const std::string &fragmentSrc, const std::string &geometrySrc) {
  return std::make_unique<OpenGLShader>(vertexSrc, fragmentSrc, geometrySrc);
}
OpenGLShader::OpenGLShader(const std::string &filename) {
  std::ifstream stream(filename);
  std::string line;
  enum ShaderType { NONE = -1, VERTEX = 0, GEOMETRY = 1, FRAGMENT = 2 }; 
  std::stringstream ss[3];
  ShaderType type = ShaderType::NONE;
  
  while (getline(stream, line)) {
    if (line.find("#shader") != std::string::npos) {
      if (line.find("vertex") != std::string::npos) {
        type = ShaderType::VERTEX;
      } else if (line.find("geometry") != std::string::npos) { // ДОБАВИЛ
        type = ShaderType::GEOMETRY;
      } else if (line.find("fragment") != std::string::npos) {
        type = ShaderType::FRAGMENT;
      }
    } else {
      if (type != ShaderType::NONE) {
        ss[(int)type] << line << '\n';
      }
    }
  }

  m_rendererID = glCreateProgram();
  
  GLuint vertexShader = CompileShader(GL_VERTEX_SHADER, ss[0].str());
  glAttachShader(m_rendererID, vertexShader);
  
  if (!ss[1].str().empty()) {
    GLuint geometryShader = CompileShader(GL_GEOMETRY_SHADER, ss[1].str());
    glAttachShader(m_rendererID, geometryShader);
  }
  
  GLuint fragmentShader = CompileShader(GL_FRAGMENT_SHADER, ss[2].str());
  glAttachShader(m_rendererID, fragmentShader);
  
  glLinkProgram(m_rendererID);
  
  GLint isLinked;
  glGetProgramiv(m_rendererID, GL_LINK_STATUS, &isLinked);
  if (!isLinked) {
    GLint maxLength;
    glGetProgramiv(m_rendererID, GL_INFO_LOG_LENGTH, &maxLength);
    std::string infoLog(maxLength, ' ');
    glGetProgramInfoLog(m_rendererID, maxLength, &maxLength, &infoLog[0]);
    std::cout << "Shader linking failed: " + infoLog << '\n';
  }
}

OpenGLShader::OpenGLShader(const std::string &vertexSrc,
                           const std::string &fragmentSrc) {
  m_rendererID = glCreateProgram();
  GLuint vertexShader = CompileShader(GL_VERTEX_SHADER, vertexSrc);
  GLuint fragmentShader = CompileShader(GL_FRAGMENT_SHADER, fragmentSrc);
  glAttachShader(m_rendererID, vertexShader);
  glAttachShader(m_rendererID, fragmentShader);
  glLinkProgram(m_rendererID);
}
OpenGLShader::OpenGLShader(const std::string &vertexSrc,
                           const std::string &geometrySrc,
                           const std::string &fragmentSrc) {
  m_rendererID = glCreateProgram();
  
  GLuint vertexShader = CompileShader(GL_VERTEX_SHADER, vertexSrc);
  GLuint geometryShader = CompileShader(GL_GEOMETRY_SHADER, geometrySrc);
  GLuint fragmentShader = CompileShader(GL_FRAGMENT_SHADER, fragmentSrc);
  
  glAttachShader(m_rendererID, vertexShader);
  glAttachShader(m_rendererID, geometryShader);
  glAttachShader(m_rendererID, fragmentShader);
  
  glLinkProgram(m_rendererID);
  
  // ПРОВЕРКА ОШИБОК
  GLint isLinked;
  glGetProgramiv(m_rendererID, GL_LINK_STATUS, &isLinked);
  if (!isLinked) {
    GLint maxLength;
    glGetProgramiv(m_rendererID, GL_INFO_LOG_LENGTH, &maxLength);
    std::string infoLog(maxLength, ' ');
    glGetProgramInfoLog(m_rendererID, maxLength, &maxLength, &infoLog[0]);
    std::cout << "Shader linking failed: " + infoLog << '\n';
  }
}

OpenGLShader::~OpenGLShader() { glDeleteProgram(m_rendererID); }

void OpenGLShader::Bind() const { glUseProgram(m_rendererID); }

void OpenGLShader::Unbind() const { glUseProgram(0); }

void OpenGLShader::SetMat4(const std::string &name, const glm::mat4 &matrix) {
  auto loc = glGetUniformLocation(m_rendererID, name.c_str());
  if (loc != -1) {
    glUniformMatrix4fv(loc, 1, GL_FALSE, &matrix[0][0]);
  } else {
    std::cout << "Warning: uniform '" + name + "' doesn't exist!\n";
  }
}

void OpenGLShader::SetVec3(const std::string &name, const glm::vec3 &vector) {
  auto loc = glGetUniformLocation(m_rendererID, name.c_str());
  if (loc != -1) {
    glUniform3fv(loc, 1, &vector[0]);
  } else {
    std::cout << "Warning: uniform '" + name + "' doesn't exist!\n";
  }
}

void OpenGLShader::SetVec4(const std::string &name, const glm::vec4 &vector) {
  auto loc = glGetUniformLocation(m_rendererID, name.c_str());
  if (loc != -1) {
    glUniform4fv(loc, 1, &vector[0]);
  } else {
    std::cout << "Warning: uniform '" + name + "' doesn't exist!\n";
  }
}
void OpenGLShader::SetInt(const std::string &name, int value) {
  auto loc = glGetUniformLocation(m_rendererID, name.c_str());
  if (loc != -1) {
    glUniform1i(loc, value);
  } else {
    std::cout << "Warning: uniform '" + name + "' doesn't exist!\n";
  }
}

void OpenGLShader::SetFloat(const std::string &name, float value) {
  auto loc = glGetUniformLocation(m_rendererID, name.c_str());
  if (loc != -1) {
    glUniform1f(loc, value);
  } else {
    std::cout << "Warning: uniform '" + name + "' doesn't exist!\n";
  }
}

void OpenGLShader::SetBool(const std::string &name, bool value) {
    auto loc = glGetUniformLocation(m_rendererID, name.c_str());
  if (loc != -1) {
    glUniform1i(loc, (int)value);
  } else {
    std::cout << "Warning: uniform '" + name + "' doesn't exist!\n";
  }
}


GLuint OpenGLShader::CompileShader(GLenum type, const std::string &source) {
  GLuint shader = glCreateShader(type);
  const char *src = source.c_str();
  glShaderSource(shader, 1, &src, nullptr);
  glCompileShader(shader);
  GLint isCompiled;
  glGetShaderiv(shader, GL_COMPILE_STATUS, &isCompiled);
  if (!isCompiled) {
    GLint maxLength;
    glGetShaderiv(shader, GL_INFO_LOG_LENGTH, &maxLength);
    std::string infoLog(maxLength, ' ');
    glGetShaderInfoLog(shader, maxLength, &maxLength, &infoLog[0]);
    glDeleteShader(shader);
    std::cout << "Shader compilation failed: " + infoLog << '\n';
  }
  return shader;
}
} // namespace engine

===== FILE: ./src/graphics/OpenGL/OpenGLTexture.cc =====
#include "OpenGLTexture.h"
#include <stb_image.h>
#include <stdexcept>
namespace engine {
std::shared_ptr<Texture> CreateOpenGLTexture(const std::string &path) {
  return std::make_shared<OpenGLTexture>(path);
}

std::shared_ptr<Texture> CreateOpenGLTexture(const TextureSpecification &spec) {
  return std::make_shared<OpenGLTexture>(spec);
}

OpenGLTexture::OpenGLTexture(const std::string &path) {
  int height, width, channels;
  stbi_set_flip_vertically_on_load(1);
  stbi_uc *data = stbi_load(path.c_str(), &width, &height, &channels, 0);
  if (data) {

    m_width = width;
    m_height = height;

    GLenum internalFormat = 0, dataFormat = 0;

    if (channels == 4) {
      internalFormat = GL_RGBA8;
      dataFormat = GL_RGBA;
    } else if (channels == 3) {
      internalFormat = GL_RGB8;
      dataFormat = GL_RGB;
    } else {
      stbi_image_free(data);
      throw std::runtime_error("Unsupported image format: " + path);
    }
    glGenTextures(1, &m_rendererID);
    glBindTexture(GL_TEXTURE_2D, m_rendererID);
    glTexImage2D(GL_TEXTURE_2D, 0, internalFormat, m_width, m_height, 0, dataFormat, GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE, data);
    glTexParameteri(GL_TEXTURE_2D, GL_TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER, GL_LINEAR);
    glTexParameteri(GL_TEXTURE_2D, GL_TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER, GL_LINEAR);
    glTexParameteri(GL_TEXTURE_2D, GL_TEXTURE_WRAP_S, GL_REPEAT);
    glTexParameteri(GL_TEXTURE_2D, GL_TEXTURE_WRAP_T, GL_REPEAT);

    stbi_image_free(data);
  } else {
    throw std::runtime_error("Failed to load texture: " + path);
  }
}
OpenGLTexture::OpenGLTexture(const TextureSpecification &spec) {}
OpenGLTexture::~OpenGLTexture() { glDeleteTextures(1, &m_rendererID); }
void OpenGLTexture::Bind(uint32_t slot) const {
  glActiveTexture(GL_TEXTURE0 + slot);
  glBindTexture(GL_TEXTURE_2D, m_rendererID);
}
void OpenGLTexture::Unbind() const {}
} // namespace nova

===== FILE: ./src/graphics/OpenGL/OpenGLVertexArrayObject.cc =====
#include "OpenGLVertexArrayObject.h"
#include <iostream>
namespace engine {

std::shared_ptr<VertexArrayObject> CreateOpenGLVertexArrayObject() {
  return std::make_shared<OpenGLVertexArrayObject>();
}
static GLenum ShaderDataTypeToOpenGLBaseType(ShaderDataType type) {
  switch (type) {
  case ShaderDataType::Float:
    return GL_FLOAT;
  case ShaderDataType::Float2:
    return GL_FLOAT;
  case ShaderDataType::Float3:
    return GL_FLOAT;
  case ShaderDataType::Float4:
    return GL_FLOAT;
  case ShaderDataType::Mat3:
    return GL_FLOAT;
  case ShaderDataType::Mat4:
    return GL_FLOAT;
  case ShaderDataType::Int:
    return GL_INT;
  case ShaderDataType::Int2:
    return GL_INT;
  case ShaderDataType::Int3:
    return GL_INT;
  case ShaderDataType::Int4:
    return GL_INT;
  case ShaderDataType::Bool:
    return GL_BOOL;
  }
  return 0;
}
OpenGLVertexArrayObject::OpenGLVertexArrayObject() {
  glGenVertexArrays(1, &m_id);
  glBindVertexArray(m_id);
}

OpenGLVertexArrayObject::~OpenGLVertexArrayObject() {
  glDeleteVertexArrays(1, &m_id);
}

void OpenGLVertexArrayObject::Bind() const { glBindVertexArray(m_id); }

void OpenGLVertexArrayObject::Unbind() const { glBindVertexArray(0); }

void OpenGLVertexArrayObject::AddVertexBuffer(
    const std::shared_ptr<VertexBuffer> &vertexBuffer) {
  glBindVertexArray(m_id);
  vertexBuffer->Bind();
  const auto &layout = vertexBuffer->GetLayout();

  for (const auto &elem : layout) {
    switch (elem.type) {
    case ShaderDataType::Float:
    case ShaderDataType::Float2:
    case ShaderDataType::Float3:
    case ShaderDataType::Float4: {
      glEnableVertexAttribArray(m_VertexBufferIndex);
      glVertexAttribPointer(m_VertexBufferIndex, elem.GetComponentCount(),
                            ShaderDataTypeToOpenGLBaseType(elem.type),
                            elem.normalized ? GL_TRUE : GL_FALSE,
                            layout.GetStride(),
                            reinterpret_cast<void *>(elem.offset));
      m_VertexBufferIndex++;
      break;
    }

    case ShaderDataType::Int:
    case ShaderDataType::Int2:
    case ShaderDataType::Int3:
    case ShaderDataType::Int4:
    case ShaderDataType::Bool: {
      glEnableVertexAttribArray(m_VertexBufferIndex);

      glVertexAttribIPointer(m_VertexBufferIndex, elem.GetComponentCount(),
                             ShaderDataTypeToOpenGLBaseType(elem.type),
                             layout.GetStride(),
                             reinterpret_cast<void *>(elem.offset));
      m_VertexBufferIndex++;
      break;
    }

    case ShaderDataType::Mat3:
    case ShaderDataType::Mat4: {
      uint8_t count = elem.GetComponentCount();
      for (uint8_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
        glEnableVertexAttribArray(m_VertexBufferIndex);
        glVertexAttribPointer(
            m_VertexBufferIndex, count,
            ShaderDataTypeToOpenGLBaseType(elem.type),
            elem.normalized ? GL_TRUE : GL_FALSE, layout.GetStride(),
            reinterpret_cast<void *>(elem.offset + sizeof(float) * count * i));
        glVertexAttribDivisor(m_VertexBufferIndex, 1);
        m_VertexBufferIndex++;
      }
    }
    default:
      std::cout << "Unknown ShaderDataType!" << std::endl;
    }
  }
  m_vertexBuffers.push_back(vertexBuffer);
}

void OpenGLVertexArrayObject::SetIndexBuffer(
    const std::shared_ptr<IndexBuffer> &indexBuffer) {
  glBindVertexArray(m_id);
  indexBuffer->Bind();
  m_indexBuffer = indexBuffer;
}
} // namespace engine

===== FILE: ./src/graphics/OpenGL/OpenGLVertexBuffer.cc =====
#include "OpenGLVertexBuffer.h"

namespace engine {
std::unique_ptr<VertexBuffer> CreateOpenGLVertexBuffer(int32_t size) {
  return std::make_unique<OpenGLVertexBuffer>(size);
}
std::unique_ptr<VertexBuffer> CreateOpenGLVertexBuffer(float *vertices,
                                                       int32_t size) {
  return std::make_unique<OpenGLVertexBuffer>(vertices, size);
}

OpenGLVertexBuffer::OpenGLVertexBuffer(int32_t size) : m_size(size) {
  glGenBuffers(1, &m_id);
  glBindBuffer(GL_ARRAY_BUFFER, m_id);
  glBufferData(GL_ARRAY_BUFFER, size, nullptr, GL_DYNAMIC_DRAW);
}
OpenGLVertexBuffer::OpenGLVertexBuffer(float *vertices, int32_t size) : m_size(size) {
  glGenBuffers(1, &m_id);
  glBindBuffer(GL_ARRAY_BUFFER, m_id);
  glBufferData(GL_ARRAY_BUFFER, size, vertices, GL_STATIC_DRAW);
}
OpenGLVertexBuffer::~OpenGLVertexBuffer() { glDeleteBuffers(1, &m_id); }

void OpenGLVertexBuffer::Bind() const { glBindBuffer(GL_ARRAY_BUFFER, m_id); }

void OpenGLVertexBuffer::Unbind() const { glBindBuffer(GL_ARRAY_BUFFER, 0); }

void OpenGLVertexBuffer::SetData(const void *data, uint32_t size) {
    glBindBuffer(GL_ARRAY_BUFFER, m_id);
    
    // ИСПОЛЬЗУЙ glBufferData вместо glBufferSubData!
    glBufferData(GL_ARRAY_BUFFER, size, data, GL_DYNAMIC_DRAW);
    m_size = size;
}

void OpenGLVertexBuffer::SetLayout(const BufferLayout &layout) {
  m_layout = layout;
}

const BufferLayout &OpenGLVertexBuffer::GetLayout() const { return m_layout; }
} // namespace engine

===== FILE: ./src/graphics/Renderer.cc =====
#include "Renderer.h"
#include "graphics/VertexArrayObject.h"
#include <glad/glad.h>
#include <glm/glm.hpp>
#include <glm/gtc/matrix_transform.hpp>
#include <memory>
static float vertices[] = {
    // front face
    -0.5f, -0.5f, 0.5f, 0.5f, -0.5f, 0.5f, 0.5f, 0.5f, 0.5f, -0.5f, 0.5f, 0.5f,

    // back face
    -0.5f, -0.5f, -0.5f, 0.5f, -0.5f, -0.5f, 0.5f, 0.5f, -0.5f, -0.5f, 0.5f,
    -0.5f};
static unsigned int indices[] = {
    // Front face
    0, 1, 2, 2, 3, 0,

    // Back face
    4, 5, 6, 6, 7, 4,

    // Left face
    0, 3, 7, 7, 4, 0,

    // Right face
    1, 5, 6, 6, 2, 1,

    // Top face
    3, 2, 6, 6, 7, 3,

    // Bottom face
    0, 1, 5, 5, 4, 0};
namespace engine {
void Renderer::Init() {
  m_shader = Shader::Create("res/shaders/shader.sh");
  m_modelShader = Shader::Create("res/shaders/model_shader.sh");
  m_fireGeometryShader = Shader::Create("res/shaders/fire_geom.sh");
  m_instanceModelShader =
      Shader::Create("res/shaders/instance_model_shader.sh");
  m_terrainShader = Shader::Create("res/shaders/terrain.sh");

  m_fireTexture = Texture::Create("res/textures/fire_texture3.png");
  m_vao = VertexArrayObject::Create();

  m_vbo = VertexBuffer::Create(vertices, sizeof(vertices));
  m_vbo->SetLayout({{ShaderDataType::Float3, "a_position"}});
  m_vao->AddVertexBuffer(m_vbo);

  m_ebo = IndexBuffer::Create(indices, sizeof(indices) / sizeof(unsigned int));
  m_vao->SetIndexBuffer(m_ebo);

  m_agentVAO = VertexArrayObject::Create();
  m_agentVBO = VertexBuffer::Create(50000 * sizeof(AgentRenderData));
  m_agentVBO->SetLayout({{ShaderDataType::Float3, "a_position"},
                         {ShaderDataType::Float, "a_intensity"},
                         {ShaderDataType::Float3, "a_bounds_min"},
                         {ShaderDataType::Float3, "a_bounds_max"}});
  m_agentVAO->AddVertexBuffer(m_agentVBO);
  m_instanceBuffer = VertexBuffer::Create(10000 * sizeof(glm::mat4));
  m_instanceBuffer->SetLayout(
      {{ShaderDataType::Float4, "a_instance_matrix0", 1},
       {ShaderDataType::Float4, "a_instance_matrix1", 1},
       {ShaderDataType::Float4, "a_instance_matrix2", 1},
       {ShaderDataType::Float4, "a_instance_matrix3", 1}});

  // Создаем отдельный VAO для инстансинга
  m_instanceVAO = VertexArrayObject::Create();
}

void Renderer::Shutdown() {}

void Renderer::DrawCube(const glm::vec3 &position, const glm::vec3 &color,
                        float scale) {
  glm::mat4 model = glm::mat4(1.0f);
  model = glm::translate(model, position);
  model = glm::scale(model, glm::vec3(scale));
  m_shader->Bind();

  m_shader->SetMat4("u_model", model);
  m_shader->SetVec3("u_color", color);
  m_shader->SetMat4("u_view", m_viewMat);
  m_shader->SetMat4("u_projection", m_projectionMat);
  m_vao->Bind();
  glDrawElements(GL_TRIANGLES, 36, GL_UNSIGNED_INT, 0);
  m_vao->Unbind();
  m_shader->Unbind();
}

void Renderer::DrawModel(Model &model, const glm::vec3 &position,
                         const glm::vec3 &scale, const glm::vec3 &camPos) {
  glm::mat4 modelmat = glm::mat4(1.0f);
  modelmat = glm::translate(modelmat, position);
  modelmat = glm::scale(modelmat, scale);
  m_modelShader->Bind();
  m_modelShader->SetMat4("u_model", modelmat);
  m_modelShader->SetMat4("u_view", m_viewMat);
  m_modelShader->SetMat4("u_projection", m_projectionMat);
  m_modelShader->SetVec3("viewPos", camPos);
  m_modelShader->SetVec3("light.position", glm::vec3(500.0f, 200.0f, 100.0f));
  m_modelShader->SetVec3("light.ambient", glm::vec3(0.2f));
  m_modelShader->SetVec3("light.diffuse", glm::vec3(0.8f));
  m_modelShader->SetVec3("light.specular", glm::vec3(1.0f));
  model.Draw(*m_modelShader);
}
void Renderer::DrawModelInstanced(Model &model,
                                  const std::vector<glm::mat4> &instances,
                                  const glm::vec3 &camPos) {
  if (instances.empty())
    return;

  m_instanceModelShader->Bind();
  m_instanceModelShader->SetMat4("u_view", m_viewMat);
  m_instanceModelShader->SetMat4("u_projection", m_projectionMat);
  m_instanceModelShader->SetVec3("viewPos", camPos);
  m_instanceModelShader->SetVec3("light.position",
                                 glm::vec3(500.0f, 200.0f, 100.0f));
  m_instanceModelShader->SetVec3("light.ambient", glm::vec3(0.2f));
  m_instanceModelShader->SetVec3("light.diffuse", glm::vec3(0.8f));
  m_instanceModelShader->SetVec3("light.specular", glm::vec3(1.0f));

  model.DrawInstanced(*m_instanceModelShader, instances);
}

void Renderer::DrawModelWithMaterial(
    Model &model, const glm::vec3 &position, const glm::vec3 &scale,
    const glm::vec3 &camPos, const std::shared_ptr<Material> &material) {

  // 1. Вычисляем матрицу модели
  glm::mat4 modelmat = glm::mat4(1.0f);
  modelmat = glm::translate(modelmat, position);
  modelmat = glm::scale(modelmat, scale);

  // 2. Биндим шейдер и устанавливаем uniform'ы
  m_modelShader->Bind();

  // ДОБАВЬ ПРОВЕРКУ:
  m_modelShader->SetMat4("u_model", modelmat);
  m_modelShader->SetMat4("u_view", m_viewMat);
  m_modelShader->SetMat4("u_projection", m_projectionMat);
  m_modelShader->SetVec3("viewPos", camPos);

  // 3. Настройка освещения (как у тебя было)
  m_modelShader->SetVec3("light.position", glm::vec3(500.0f, 200.0f, 100.0f));
  m_modelShader->SetVec3("light.ambient", glm::vec3(0.2f));
  m_modelShader->SetVec3("light.diffuse", glm::vec3(0.8f));
  m_modelShader->SetVec3("light.specular", glm::vec3(1.0f));

  // 4. Биндим материал (если он есть)
  if (material) {
    material->Bind(*m_modelShader);
  } else {
    m_modelShader->SetBool("material.use_diffuse_map", false);
    m_modelShader->SetBool("material.use_specular_map", false);
    m_modelShader->SetVec3("material.diffuse", glm::vec3(0.8f));
    m_modelShader->SetVec3("material.specular", glm::vec3(0.5f));
    m_modelShader->SetFloat("material.shininess", 32.0f);
  }

  model.DrawGeometryOnly(*m_modelShader);
}

void Renderer::BeginScene(const glm::mat4 &view, const glm::mat4 &projection) {
  glClearColor(0.1, 0.1, 0.1, 1.0f);

  glClear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT | GL_DEPTH_BUFFER_BIT);
  glEnable(GL_DEPTH_TEST);
  glEnable(GL_CULL_FACE);
  glCullFace(GL_BACK);
  glFrontFace(GL_CCW);
  m_viewMat = view;
  m_projectionMat = projection;
}
void Renderer::UploadAgentsData(const std::vector<Agent> &agents) {
  m_agentRenderData.clear();
  for (const auto &agent : agents) {
    if (!agent.isBurning())
      continue;
    AgentRenderData data;
    data.position =
        glm::vec3(agent.position.x, agent.position.y, agent.position.z);
    data.intensity = agent.getOverallIntensity();

    data.bounds_min = glm::vec3(agent.fire_collider.bounds_min.x,
                                agent.fire_collider.bounds_min.y,
                                agent.fire_collider.bounds_min.z);
    data.bounds_max = glm::vec3(agent.fire_collider.bounds_max.x,
                                agent.fire_collider.bounds_max.y,
                                agent.fire_collider.bounds_max.z);

    m_agentRenderData.push_back(data);
  }
  if (!m_agentRenderData.empty()) {
    m_agentVBO->Bind();
    m_agentVBO->SetData(m_agentRenderData.data(),
                        m_agentRenderData.size() * sizeof(AgentRenderData));
  }
}

void Renderer::EndScene() {
  glBindVertexArray(0);
  glUseProgram(0);
}

void Renderer::RenderWithGeometryShader(const glm::vec3 &wind_force) {
  glEnable(GL_BLEND);
  glBlendFunc(GL_SRC_ALPHA, GL_ONE);
  glDepthMask(GL_FALSE);

  m_fireGeometryShader->Bind();
  m_fireGeometryShader->SetMat4("u_view", m_viewMat);
  m_fireGeometryShader->SetMat4("u_projection", m_projectionMat);
  m_fireGeometryShader->SetFloat("u_time", glfwGetTime());
  m_fireGeometryShader->SetVec3("u_wind_force", wind_force);

  glm::mat4 view = m_viewMat;
  glm::vec3 camera_right = glm::vec3(view[0][0], view[1][0], view[2][0]);
  glm::vec3 camera_up = glm::vec3(view[0][1], view[1][1], view[2][1]);

  m_fireGeometryShader->SetVec3("u_camera_right", camera_right);
  m_fireGeometryShader->SetVec3("u_camera_up", camera_up);
  m_fireTexture->Bind(0);
  m_fireGeometryShader->SetInt("u_fire_texture", 0);
  m_agentVAO->Bind();
  glDrawArrays(GL_POINTS, 0, m_agentRenderData.size());
  m_agentVAO->Unbind();

  m_fireGeometryShader->Unbind();

  glDepthMask(GL_TRUE);
  glDisable(GL_BLEND);
}

void Renderer::DrawTerrain(std::shared_ptr<VertexArrayObject> vao,
                           const glm::vec3 &camPos) {
  if (!vao || !m_terrainShader)
    return;

  auto ib = vao->GetIndexBuffer();
  uint32_t count = ib ? ib->GetCount() : 0;

  m_terrainShader->Bind();
  m_terrainShader->SetMat4("u_View", m_viewMat);
  m_terrainShader->SetMat4("u_Projection", m_projectionMat);
  m_terrainShader->SetMat4("u_Model", glm::mat4(1.0f));

  m_terrainShader->SetVec3("u_LightPos", glm::vec3(100.0f, 100.0f, 100.0f));
  m_terrainShader->SetFloat("u_MaxHeight", 80.0f);

  vao->Bind();
  glDrawElements(GL_TRIANGLES, count, GL_UNSIGNED_INT, nullptr);
}
} // namespace engine

===== FILE: ./src/graphics/VertexBuffer.h =====
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>
#include <glad/glad.h>
#include <memory>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
namespace engine {
enum class ShaderDataType {
  Float,
  Float2,
  Float3,
  Float4,
  Int,
  Int2,
  Int3,
  Int4,
  Mat3,
  Mat4,
  Bool
};
static uint32_t ShaderDataTypeSize(ShaderDataType type) {
  switch (type) {
  case ShaderDataType::Float:
    return 4;
  case ShaderDataType::Float2:
    return 4 * 2;
  case ShaderDataType::Float3:
    return 4 * 3;
  case ShaderDataType::Float4:
    return 4 * 4;
  case ShaderDataType::Mat3:
    return 4 * 3 * 3;
  case ShaderDataType::Mat4:
    return 4 * 4 * 4;
  case ShaderDataType::Int:
    return 4;
  case ShaderDataType::Int2:
    return 4 * 2;
  case ShaderDataType::Int3:
    return 4 * 3;
  case ShaderDataType::Int4:
    return 4 * 4;
  case ShaderDataType::Bool:
    return 1;
  }
  return 0;
}
struct BufferElement {
  ShaderDataType type;
  std::string name;
  uint32_t size;
  uint32_t offset;
  bool normalized;
  BufferElement(ShaderDataType type, const std::string &name,
                bool normalized = false)
      : name(name), type(type), size(ShaderDataTypeSize(type)), offset(0),
        normalized(normalized) {}
  uint32_t GetComponentCount() const {
    switch (type) {
    case ShaderDataType::Float:
      return 1;
    case ShaderDataType::Float2:
      return 2;
    case ShaderDataType::Float3:
      return 3;
    case ShaderDataType::Float4:
      return 4;
    case ShaderDataType::Int:
      return 1;
    case ShaderDataType::Int2:
      return 2;
    case ShaderDataType::Int3:
      return 3;
    case ShaderDataType::Int4:
      return 4;
    case ShaderDataType::Mat3:
      return 3;
    case ShaderDataType::Mat4:
      return 4;
    case ShaderDataType::Bool:
      return 1;
    }
    return 0;
  }
};

class BufferLayout {
private:
  std::vector<BufferElement> m_elements;
  uint32_t m_Stride = 0;

public:
  BufferLayout() = default;
  BufferLayout(const std::initializer_list<BufferElement> &elements)
      : m_elements(elements) {
    CalculateOffsetsAndStride();
  }
  const std::vector<BufferElement> &GetElements() const { return m_elements; }
  uint32_t GetStride() const { return m_Stride; }
  // Итераторы для for-each
  std::vector<BufferElement>::iterator begin() { return m_elements.begin(); }
  std::vector<BufferElement>::iterator end() { return m_elements.end(); }
  std::vector<BufferElement>::const_iterator begin() const {
    return m_elements.begin();
  }
  std::vector<BufferElement>::const_iterator end() const {
    return m_elements.end();
  }

private:
  void CalculateOffsetsAndStride() {
    size_t offset = 0;
    m_Stride = 0;
    for (auto &element : m_elements) {
      element.offset = offset;
      offset += element.size;
      m_Stride += element.size;
    }
  }
};

class VertexBuffer {
private:
  GLuint m_id;
public:
  virtual ~VertexBuffer() = default;

  virtual void Bind() const = 0;
  virtual void Unbind() const = 0;
  virtual void SetData(const void *data, uint32_t size) = 0;
  virtual void SetLayout(const BufferLayout &layout) = 0;
  virtual size_t GetSize() const = 0;
  virtual const BufferLayout &GetLayout() const = 0;
  static std::shared_ptr<VertexBuffer> Create(int32_t size);
  static std::shared_ptr<VertexBuffer> Create(float *vertices, int32_t size);
};

} // namespace engine

===== FILE: ./src/math/ScreenRay.h =====
#pragma once
#include <cmath>
#include <glm/glm.hpp>
#include <glm/gtc/matrix_inverse.hpp>

namespace math {
inline void ScreenPointToRay(float px, float py, float viewportW,
                             float viewportH, const glm::mat4 &proj,
                             const glm::mat4 &view, glm::vec3 &outOrigin,
                             glm::vec3 &outDir) {
  float x = (2.0F * px / viewportW) - 1.0F;
  float y = 1.0F - (2.0F * py / viewportH);
  glm::vec4 ray_clip(x, y, -1.0F, 1.0F);
  glm::mat4 inv_proj = glm::inverse(proj);
  glm::vec4 ray_eye = inv_proj * ray_clip;
  ray_eye = glm::vec4(ray_eye.x, ray_eye.y, -1.0f, 0.0f);
  glm::mat4 inv_view = glm::inverse(view);
  glm::vec4 ray_world4 = inv_view * ray_eye;
  glm::vec3 ray_world = glm::normalize(glm::vec3(ray_world4));
  outOrigin = glm::vec3(inv_view[3]);
  outDir = ray_world;
}

inline bool IntersectRayPlaneY0(const glm::vec3 &ro, const glm::vec3 &rd,
                                glm::vec3 &hit) {
  if (std::fabs(rd.y) < 1e-6F) {
    return false;
}
  float t = -ro.y / rd.y;
  if (t < 0.0F) {
    return false;
}
  hit = ro + rd * t;
  return true;
}

inline bool IntersectRayPlaneAtDepth(const glm::vec3 &ro, const glm::vec3 &rd,
                                     const glm::vec3 &camDir, float depth,
                                     glm::vec3 &hit) {
  // Плоскость: нормаль = camDir, точка на плоскости = ro + depth * camDir
  glm::vec3 planePoint = ro + depth * camDir;
  float denom = glm::dot(rd, camDir);
  if (std::fabs(denom) < 1e-6f) {
    return false; // Луч параллелен плоскости
  }
  float t = glm::dot(planePoint - ro, camDir) / denom;
  if (t < 0.0f) {
    return false; // Пересечение позади камеры
  }
  hit = ro + rd * t;
  return true;
}
} // namespace math

#include "ui/backends/ImGuiBackend.h"
#include <imgui.h>

// clang-format off
// NOLINTBEGIN(llvm-include-order)
#ifndef GLFW_INCLUDE_NONE
#define GLFW_INCLUDE_NONE
#endif
#include <glad/glad.h>
#include <GLFW/glfw3.h>
// NOLINTEND(llvm-include-order)

#include <backends/imgui_impl_glfw.h>

namespace {
constexpr ImGuiConfigFlags Or(ImGuiConfigFlags first, ImGuiConfigFlags second) {
  return static_cast<ImGuiConfigFlags>(static_cast<unsigned>(first) |
                                       static_cast<unsigned>(second));
}
} // namespace

void ui::ImGuiBackend::Init(GLFWwindow *ui_window, const char *glsl) {
  IMGUI_CHECKVERSION();
  ImGui::CreateContext();

  ImGuiIO &io = ImGui::GetIO();
  io.ConfigFlags = Or(io.ConfigFlags, ImGuiConfigFlags_DockingEnable);
  io.ConfigFlags = Or(io.ConfigFlags, ImGuiConfigFlags_NavEnableKeyboard);

  ImGui::StyleColorsDark();

  ImGui_ImplGlfw_InitForOpenGL(ui_window, /*install_callbacks=*/true);
  ImGui_ImplOpenGL3_Init(glsl);
}

void ui::ImGuiBackend::Shutdown() {
  ImGui_ImplOpenGL3_Shutdown();
  ImGui_ImplGlfw_Shutdown();
  ImGui::DestroyContext();
}

void ui::ImGuiBackend::BeginFrame() {
  ImGui_ImplOpenGL3_NewFrame();
  ImGui_ImplGlfw_NewFrame();
  ImGui::NewFrame();
}

void ui::ImGuiBackend::EndFrame() {
  ImGui::Render();
  ImGui_ImplOpenGL3_RenderDrawData(ImGui::GetDrawData());
}

void ui::ImGuiBackend::DrawDockspace()
{
    ImGuiIO& io = ImGui::GetIO();
    ImGuiViewport* viewport = ImGui::GetMainViewport();

    // Хост-окно на весь экран без фона
    ImGui::SetNextWindowPos(viewport->Pos);
    ImGui::SetNextWindowSize(viewport->Size);
    ImGui::SetNextWindowViewport(viewport->ID);

    ImGuiWindowFlags host_flags =
        ImGuiWindowFlags_NoDocking |
        ImGuiWindowFlags_NoTitleBar |
        ImGuiWindowFlags_NoCollapse |
        ImGuiWindowFlags_NoResize |
        ImGuiWindowFlags_NoMove |
        ImGuiWindowFlags_NoBringToFrontOnFocus |
        ImGuiWindowFlags_NoNavFocus |
        ImGuiWindowFlags_NoBackground; // ← важное: нет фона, сцена видна

    ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_WindowRounding, 0.0f);
    ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_WindowBorderSize, 0.0f);

    ImGui::Begin("##DockSpaceHost", nullptr, host_flags);
    ImGui::PopStyleVar(2);

    // Сам докспейс — с Passthru в центре
    ImGuiID dockspace_id = ImGui::GetID("MainDockSpace");
    ImGuiDockNodeFlags dock_flags = ImGuiDockNodeFlags_PassthruCentralNode; // ← оставляем
    ImGui::DockSpace(dockspace_id, ImVec2(0.0f, 0.0f), dock_flags);

    ImGui::End();
}

#pragma once
#include <glm/glm.hpp>
#include <string>
#include "ui/EditorState.h"
#include "ui/ToolType.h"

struct GLFWwindow;
namespace engine {
class Scene;
class Camera;

}  // namespace engine

namespace ui {
class Editor;  // <-- только форвард!

struct EditorContext {
  engine::Application* m_app = nullptr;
  GLFWwindow* m_window = nullptr;
  engine::Scene* m_scene = nullptr;
  const engine::Camera* m_camera = nullptr;

  glm::mat4 m_view{}, m_proj{};
  int m_viewportW = 1920, m_viewportH = 1080;
  int vpX{0}, vpY{0}, vpW{1920}, vpH{1080};
  float m_vpScaleX{1.F}, m_vpScaleY{1.F};

  Editor* m_editor = nullptr;  // не владеем

  // Только объявления — БЕЗ ТЕЛ в .h!
  EditorState& State();
  [[nodiscard]] const EditorState& State() const;

  [[nodiscard]] ToolType GetActiveToolType() const noexcept;

  [[nodiscard]] glm::vec2 WindowToViewportLogical(float mx, float my) const {
    return {mx - static_cast<float>(vpX), my - static_cast<float>(vpY)};
  }
  [[nodiscard]] glm::vec2 WindowToViewportFB(float mx, float my) const {
    return {(mx - static_cast<float>(vpX)) * m_vpScaleX,
            (my - static_cast<float>(vpY)) * m_vpScaleY};
  }
};
}  // namespace ui


===== FILE: ./src/ui/Editor.h =====
// ui/Editor.h
#pragma once
#include <memory>
#include <ranges>
#include <type_traits>
#include <vector>

#include "ui/EditorState.h"
#include "ui/IModule.h"
#include "ui/IPanel.h"
#include "ui/ITool.h"
// не инклюдим IModule тут — достаточно fwd-decl
namespace ui {
struct IModule;
} // namespace ui

namespace ui {
  struct EditorContext;

class Editor {
public:
  Editor() = default;

  // Запрет копирования
  Editor(const Editor &) = delete;
  Editor &operator=(const Editor &) = delete;

  // Перемещение: переносим владение, но сбрасываем стек (переактивация позже)
  Editor(Editor &&other) noexcept
      : m_panels(std::move(other.m_panels)), m_tools(std::move(other.m_tools)),
        m_modules(std::move(other.m_modules)) {
    m_activeStack.clear();
  }

  Editor &operator=(Editor &&other) noexcept {
    if (this != &other) {
      ShutdownModules(); // на всякий случай корректно выгружаем свои
      m_panels = std::move(other.m_panels);
      m_tools = std::move(other.m_tools);
      m_modules = std::move(other.m_modules);
      m_activeStack.clear();
    }
    return *this;
  }

  ~Editor() {
    // Гарантируем Shutdown модулей перед разрушением редактора
    for (auto &m_module : std::ranges::reverse_view(m_modules)) {
      m_module->Shutdown();
    }
  }

  // --- Регистрация панелей/инструментов (как было) ---
  void RegisterPanel(std::unique_ptr<IPanel> panel) {
    m_panels.emplace_back(std::move(panel));
  }
  void RegisterTool(std::unique_ptr<ITool> tool) {
    m_tools.emplace_back(std::move(tool));
  }

  template <class T> T *GetTool() {
    static_assert(std::is_base_of_v<ITool, T>, "T must be ITool");
    for (auto &up : m_tools) {
      if (auto *tool_pointer = dynamic_cast<T *>(up.get())) {
        return tool_pointer;
      }
    }
    return nullptr;
  }
  template <class T> const T *GetTool() const {
    static_assert(std::is_base_of_v<ITool, T>, "T must be ITool");
    for (const auto &up : m_tools) {
      if (auto *tool_pointer = dynamic_cast<const T *>(up.get())) {
        return tool_pointer;
      }
    }
    return nullptr;
  }

  // --- Модули ---
  void RegisterModule(std::unique_ptr<IModule> module) {
    m_modules.emplace_back(std::move(module));
    m_modules.back()->Startup(*this);
  }

  // При желании — явная остановка модулей до деструктора
  void ShutdownModules() {
    for (auto &m_module : std::ranges::reverse_view(m_modules)) {
      m_module->Shutdown();
    }
  }

  // --- Активные инструменты (как уже сделали) ---
  void SetActiveTool(ToolType type, EditorContext &ctx) {
    if (!m_activeStack.empty()) {
      m_activeStack.back()->OnDeactivate(ctx);
      m_activeStack.clear();
    }
    if (auto *tool = FindTool(type)) {
      m_activeStack.push_back(tool);
      tool->OnActivate(ctx);
    }
  }
  void PushTool(ToolType type, EditorContext &ctx) {
    if (auto *tool = FindTool(type)) {
      if (!m_activeStack.empty()) {
        m_activeStack.back()->OnDeactivate(ctx);
      }
      m_activeStack.push_back(tool);
      tool->OnActivate(ctx);
    }
  }
  void PopTool(EditorContext &ctx) {
    if (m_activeStack.empty()) {
      return;
    }
    m_activeStack.back()->OnDeactivate(ctx);
    m_activeStack.pop_back();
    if (!m_activeStack.empty()) {
      m_activeStack.back()->OnActivate(ctx);
    }
  }

  void DrawUI(EditorContext &ctx) {
    ctx.m_editor = this;
    for (auto &panel : m_panels) {
      panel->Draw(ctx);
    }
  }
  void TickTools(EditorContext &ctx) {
    if (!m_activeStack.empty()) {
      m_activeStack.back()->OnUpdate(ctx);
    }
  }

  [[nodiscard]] ToolType ActiveToolType() const {
    return m_activeStack.empty() ? ToolType::OTHER_TOOL
                                 : m_activeStack.back()->Type();
  }
  EditorState m_state;

private:
  ITool *FindTool(ToolType type) {
    for (auto &tool : m_tools) {
      if (tool->Type() == type) {
        return tool.get();
      }
    }
    return nullptr;
  }

  std::vector<std::unique_ptr<IPanel>> m_panels;
  std::vector<std::unique_ptr<ITool>> m_tools;
  std::vector<ITool *> m_activeStack;
  std::vector<std::unique_ptr<IModule>> m_modules; // <-- NEW
};

} // namespace ui
